    HiMA-Ecom: A Long-Horizon Memory Benchmark for Hierarchical Multi-Agent E-commerce Assistants

    HiMA-Ecom：面向分层多智能体电商助手的长时程记忆基准

    Junxing Hu, Ai Han, Haolan Zhan, Pu Wei, Zhiqian Zhang, Yuhang Guo, Jiawei Lu, Zhen Chen, Haoran Li, Zicheng Zhang, Ling Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes a long-horizon memory benchmark and a multi-agent RL method for managing context and memory. Its agent organization, memory evolution, and computational efficiency make Systems a core focus; hierarchical agents alone do not establish substantive compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文提出长时程记忆基准和一种用于管理上下文与记忆的多智能体 RL 方法。智能体组织、记忆演化和计算效率是其核心系统研究重点；仅有分层智能体这一点，并不能证明存在实质性的组合泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon agentic systems become long-context systems by accumulation rather than through a single long document, since every step reassembles a prompt from role instructions, tool and sub-agent descriptions, recalled memories, dialogue history, and previous tool outputs, separately for every agent. This paper studies how such accumulated context can be trained, evaluated, and managed in hierarchical multi-agent assistants. We present HiMA-Ecom, a hierarchical multi-agent benchmark for e-commerce assistants with 22.8K instances, of which 17.7K carry memory entries in context, pairing agent-specific supervised fine-tuning data with system-level supervision for end-to-end multi-agent reinforcement learning. Building upon it, HiMA-R1 keeps the context budget of a trajectory under control through Variance-Reduction Group Relative Policy Optimization (VR-GRPO), which samples along an initial trajectory so that sampling cost grows additively with trajectory length and updates the agents with the largest reward variance, together with an efficiency reward on trajectory length and a memory evolution mechanism that repurposes GRPO rewards as cost-free signals for what stays in context. Agents built upon 3B and 7B open-source models match DeepSeek-R1 and surpass DeepSeek-V3 by 6.0 points on average, while reward-driven memory reduces the update steps needed for convergence by roughly 55%.

    中文

    长时程智能体系统通过不断累积而成为长上下文系统，而非依靠单篇长文档，因为每一步都要针对每个智能体分别重新组装提示，其中包括角色指令、工具与子智能体描述、回忆出的记忆、对话历史以及先前的工具输出。本文研究如何在分层多智能体助手中训练、评估和管理这种累积的上下文。我们提出 HiMA-Ecom，这是一个面向电商助手的分层多智能体基准，包含 22.8K 个实例，其中 17.7K 个实例在上下文中带有记忆条目；该基准将针对智能体的监督微调数据与系统级监督配对，用于端到端多智能体强化学习。在此基础上，HiMA-R1 通过方差缩减组相对策略优化（Variance-Reduction Group Relative Policy Optimization，VR-GRPO）控制轨迹的上下文预算：该方法沿初始轨迹进行采样，使采样成本随轨迹长度加法式增长，并更新奖励方差最大的智能体；同时，它结合了针对轨迹长度的效率奖励，以及一种记忆演化机制，将 GRPO 奖励重新用作判断哪些内容应留在上下文中的零成本信号。基于 3B 和 7B 开源模型构建的智能体表现与 DeepSeek-R1 相当，平均分数超过 DeepSeek-V3 6.0 分；而由奖励驱动的记忆机制使收敛所需的更新步数减少约 55%。

    TS-DP: Reinforcement Speculative Decoding For Temporal Adaptive Diffusion Policy Acceleration

    TS-DP：用于加速时序自适应扩散策略的强化学习投机解码

    Ye Li, Jiahe Feng, Yuan Meng, Kangye Ji, Chen Tang, Jiajun Fan, Xinwan Wen, Jiawei Li, Wenwu Zhu, Shu-Tao Xia, Xin Wang, Zhi Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TS-DP combines a distilled drafter with an RL scheduler that adapts speculative computation to changing task difficulty, accelerating diffusion-policy inference while maintaining control performance. Dynamic computation and scheduling are a core systems contribution; reinforcement learning supports this allocation, but the abstract does not establish a broader advance in reasoning.

    TS-DP 将蒸馏得到的起草模型与 RL 调度器结合起来，使投机计算能够适应不断变化的任务难度，从而加速扩散策略推理，同时保持控制性能。动态计算与调度是其核心系统贡献；强化学习用于支持资源分配，但摘要并未证明其在更广泛的推理方面取得了进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion Policy (DP) excels in embodied control but suffers from high inference latency and computational cost due to multiple iterative denoising steps. Existing diffusion model (DMs) acceleration methods improve inference speed by reducing computational overhead, as DMs for image generation are computation-bound. In this work, we reveal that DP are I/O bound, and thus propose using speculative decoding, a parallel computing framework, to accelerate DP for the first time. However, it is non-trivial to address the following challenges: (1) How to preserve the denoising quality of the base model at reduced computational cost under time-varying task difficulty in embodied settings; and (2) How to dynamically allocate computation according to task difficulty in such environments. Therefore, we propose Temporal-aware Reinforcement-based Speculative Diffusion Policy (TS-DP), the first framework that enables speculative decoding for DP with temporal adaptivity. First, to handle dynamic environments where task difficulty varies over time, we distill a Transformer-based drafter to imitate the base model and replace its costly denoising calls. Second, an RL-based scheduler further adapts to the time-varying task difficulty by adjusting speculative parameters to maintain accuracy while improving efficiency. Extensive experiments show that TS-DP achieves up to a 4.17x NFE reduction and a 3.2x wall-clock speedup with a draft acceptance rate of over 85% in simulation. Real-world experiments further demonstrate a 3.8x NFE reduction while improving success rates on real-time tasks (e.g., a 23% gain on the conveyor-belt task), reaching an inference frequency of 26 Hz and enabling real-time control while maintaining comparable task performance. The code is available at https://github.com/ChildTang/TS-DP.

    中文

    扩散策略（DP）在具身控制方面表现出色，但由于包含多个迭代去噪步骤，推理延迟高、计算成本大。现有扩散模型（DM）加速方法通过降低计算开销来提高推理速度，因为用于图像生成的 DM 受计算限制。本文揭示 DP 受 I/O 限制，因此首次提出使用并行计算框架投机解码来加速 DP。然而，解决以下挑战并非易事：（1）在具身场景中任务难度随时间变化时，如何以更低的计算成本保持基础模型的去噪质量；（2）如何在此类环境中根据任务难度动态分配计算资源。因此，我们提出时序感知的强化学习投机扩散策略（TS-DP），这是首个支持 DP 投机解码并具备时序自适应能力的框架。首先，为应对任务难度随时间变化的动态环境，我们蒸馏了一个基于 Transformer 的起草模型，使其模仿基础模型并替代代价高昂的去噪调用。其次，基于 RL 的调度器通过调整投机参数，进一步适应随时间变化的任务难度，从而在提升效率的同时保持准确性。大量实验表明，在仿真中，TS-DP 的 NFE 最多减少 4.17 倍，墙钟时间加速 3.2 倍，起草结果接受率超过 85%。真实世界实验进一步表明，TS-DP 的 NFE 减少了 3.8 倍，同时提高了实时任务的成功率（例如，传送带任务提升 23%），推理频率达到 26 Hz，在保持任务性能相当的同时实现实时控制。代码见 https://github.com/ChildTang/TS-DP.

    Distilling Metacognitive Behaviors through Agentic Editing

    通过智能体式编辑蒸馏元认知行为

    Ik-hwan Kim, Hyeongrok Han, Mingi Jung, Sangwon Yu, Jinseok Hong, Sang Hun Kim, Yoonyoung Choi, Sungroh Yoon

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MBT-A edits teacher traces to add planning, verification, and other metacognitive behaviors, then trains students and measures transfer to mathematical reasoning. This directly advances reasoning training; line-by-line agentic editing is a supporting workflow, while the paper does not study internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    MBT-A 编辑教师轨迹，加入规划、验证及其他元认知行为，然后训练学生模型并衡量这些行为向数学推理的迁移。这直接推进了推理训练；逐行智能体式编辑是辅助工作流，而本文没有研究内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Distilling long reasoning traces from a teacher model into a smaller student also passes on the teacher's reasoning habits. Prior work and our annotation of teacher traces show that current reasoning models often start without a plan, verify superficially, abandon promising solution paths, and take unchecked shortcuts. We propose Metacognitive Behavioral Tuning (MBT), which inserts seven metacognitive behaviors into teacher traces at the points where the reasoning lacks them and then trains the student on the edited traces. Because teacher traces are long, how the edits are made matters. Rewriting a whole trace at once summarizes long traces, and choosing all insertion points at once crowds them at the start and end. Our agentic method, MBT-A, edits the trace file line by line and records each edit as a git commit, which avoids summarizing long traces and spreads the insertions. On competition math, a Qwen3.5-4B-Base student trained on MBT-A traces scores 85.4 against 83.1 for SFT on the unedited traces and also outperforms a token-matched control and five prior methods. MBT-A improves two other students as well, and the inserted behaviors clearly transfer to the students' reasoning, with rare ones several times more frequent.

    中文

    将教师模型的长推理轨迹蒸馏到较小的学生模型中，也会传递教师的推理习惯。以往研究和我们对教师轨迹的标注表明，当前推理模型经常在没有计划的情况下开始，验证流于表面，放弃有希望的解题路径，并采用未经核查的捷径。我们提出元认知行为调优（MBT），在教师轨迹缺少相应推理行为的位置插入七种元认知行为，然后用编辑后的轨迹训练学生模型。由于教师轨迹很长，编辑方式很重要。一次性重写整条轨迹会对长轨迹进行概括，而一次性选定所有插入点则会使插入内容集中在开头和结尾。我们提出的智能体式方法 MBT-A 逐行编辑轨迹文件，并将每次编辑记录为一次 git 提交，从而避免概括长轨迹并使插入内容分布更均匀。在竞赛数学任务上，使用 MBT-A 轨迹训练的 Qwen3.5-4B-Base 学生模型得分为 85.4，而使用未编辑轨迹进行 SFT 的得分为 83.1；它也优于一个词元数量匹配的对照模型和此前的五种方法。MBT-A 还提升了另外两个学生模型的表现；插入的行为显然迁移到了学生模型的推理中，其中原本少见的行为出现频率提高了数倍。

    Scaling Reasoning Efficiently via Relaxed On-Policy Distillation

    通过宽松的在线策略蒸馏高效扩展推理能力

    Jongwoo Ko, Sara Abdali, Young Jin Kim, Tianyi Chen, Pashmina Cameron

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a training method that reallocates teacher feedback across tokens to improve the efficiency and stability of reasoning distillation, directly advancing reasoning capability development. Distillation and test-time scaling are incidental systems connections; the abstract gives no substantive model-organization contribution.

    本文提出一种重新分配令牌间教师反馈的训练方法，以提高推理蒸馏的效率和稳定性，直接推动推理能力的发展。蒸馏和测试时扩展只是与系统的附带联系；摘要没有给出实质性的模型组织方面贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach for transferring reasoning capabilities to capacity-constrained models, yet sampled-token OPD often suffers from entropy collapse and negative transfer. We identify uniform credit allocation as a key bottleneck: existing objectives obtain dense teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories, but apply it uniformly across sampled tokens despite highly heterogeneous token-level signals. Most tokens carry redundant near-zero credit, while rare heavy-tailed negative credits can dominate updates and prematurely suppress plausible reasoning trajectories. We introduce REOPOLD (Relaxed On-Policy Distillation), a framework that relaxes this uniform assignment by controlling where teacher feedback is applied, how strongly it affects the update, and when the allocation rule changes during training. Across diverse reasoning tasks, REOPOLD improves sampled-token OPD over recent post-training baselines with up to 12x higher sample efficiency, and extends to cross-vocabulary distillation, self-distillation, and test-time scaling.

    中文

    在线策略蒸馏（OPD）是一种将推理能力迁移到容量受限模型的有前景方法，但基于采样令牌的 OPD 常遭遇熵塌缩和负迁移。我们指出，统一分配信用度是一个关键瓶颈：现有目标函数会在学生生成的轨迹上获得密集的教师反馈，却不顾令牌级信号的高度异质性，将反馈均匀地应用于采样令牌。大多数令牌承载冗余且接近零的信用度，而罕见的重尾负信用度可能主导更新，并过早压制合理的推理轨迹。我们提出 REOPOLD（宽松在线策略蒸馏），这是一个通过控制教师反馈应用于何处、对更新产生多大影响，以及训练期间何时改变分配规则，来放宽这种统一分配的框架。在多种推理任务上，与近期后训练基线相比，REOPOLD 改进了基于采样令牌的 OPD，样本效率最高提升 12 倍，并可扩展至跨词表蒸馏、自蒸馏和测试时扩展。

    The Geometry of Learning: Read-Write Asymmetry Across Training

    学习的几何：训练中的读写不对称性

    Valeria Ruscio, Keiran Thompson

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper directly analyzes how training stages shape transformer weight-update directions relative to activation and prediction geometry, explaining read-write asymmetry mechanistically. Its discussion of prediction changes is incidental to this representation-geometry contribution, with no substantive composition or systems focus.

    本论文直接分析训练阶段如何塑造 Transformer 权重更新方向，使其相对于激活几何和预测几何呈现何种关系，并从机制上解释读写不对称性。关于预测变化的讨论只是这一表示几何贡献中的附带内容，没有实质性的组合或系统侧重点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Pretraining and alignment update the same transformer weights, and we ask in which directions each stage changes them. The residual stream gives every matrix a shared coordinate system, in which a weight change can be compared with the principal subspace of the activations the matrix reads and with the prediction subspace of the unembedding. In this frame, alignment updates to the query and key matrices are enriched in the principal input subspace, while its updates to the output matrices are close to random relative to the prediction subspace, and the same signature appears in late pretraining and under every objective we apply to one checkpoint, so it is a property of the training stage rather than of the objective. The gradient of a linear map is a sum of outer products $\delta_t a_t^\top$, and the residual stream enters this product through the activation $a_t$ for matrices that read from it and through the upstream gradient $\delta_t$ for matrices that write into it. Read gradients therefore inherit the spectrum of the activations, which is the same under every objective, while write gradients inherit the geometry of the upstream gradients, which point into the prediction subspace only early in pretraining, when the output matrices acquire their prediction geometry. The raw read gradient follows the activation spectrum, the optimiser attenuates the concentration it inherits, and cancellation between tokens sets the scale of the update but not its direction. A write direction derived from the unembedding still changes predictions after alignment, and adaptation restricted to any single group of matrices remains effective, so the signature describes where training places its updates, not which matrices can carry them.

    中文

    预训练和对齐会更新同一组 Transformer 权重，我们探究每个阶段沿哪些方向改变这些权重。残差流为每个矩阵提供了一个共享坐标系，在这个坐标系中，权重变化可以与该矩阵读取的激活的主子空间以及反嵌入的预测子空间进行比较。在这一框架下，对齐阶段对查询矩阵和键矩阵的更新集中于主输入子空间，而对输出矩阵的更新相对于预测子空间接近随机；同样的特征也出现在预训练后期，以及我们对一个检查点施加的每一种目标下，因此这是训练阶段的属性，而非目标函数的属性。线性映射的梯度是外积之和，而残差流通过激活进入这一乘积（对于从中读取的矩阵），并通过上游梯度进入这一乘积（对于写入其中的矩阵）。读取梯度因此继承激活的谱，而激活的谱在所有目标下都相同；写入梯度则继承上游梯度的几何结构，而上游梯度只有在预训练早期才指向预测子空间，此时输出矩阵会获得其预测几何结构。原始读取梯度遵循激活谱，优化器会削弱它所继承的集中性，而 token 之间的抵消决定更新的尺度，却不决定其方向。由反嵌入导出的写入方向在对齐之后仍会改变预测结果；而将适配限制在任意单一组矩阵中仍然有效，因此这一特征描述的是训练将更新置于何处，而非哪些矩阵能够承载这些更新。$\delta_t a_t^\top$本论文直接分析训练阶段如何塑造 Transformer 权重更新方向相对于激活几何和预测几何的关系，并从机制上解释读写不对称性。文中对预测变化的讨论只是这一表示几何贡献中的附带内容，没有实质性的组合或系统侧重点。政府?$a_t$政府?$\delta_t$政府?

    An Asymptotic Theory of Chain-of-Thought in In-Context Learning

    上下文学习中思维链的渐近理论

    Kaito Takanami, Cengiz Pehlevan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives a theoretical account of how chain-of-thought depth affects generalization, including phase transitions, optimal depth, and error amplification. Its iterative refinement model is incidental to systems design, and the abstract offers no substantive account of internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文推导了思维链深度如何影响泛化的理论解释，其中包括相变、最优深度和误差放大。其迭代细化模型与系统设计的联系只是附带的，摘要也没有实质探讨内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has become a widely used mechanism for eliciting multi-step reasoning in large language models by generating intermediate reasoning steps at inference time. Yet the scaling behavior of generalization with CoT depth remains poorly understood. To address this question, we study a theoretically solvable model of CoT for in-context weight prediction in linear regression, where test-time reasoning is represented as an iterative refinement of the weight-parameter estimate. Using tools from random matrix theory under high-dimensional asymptotics, we derive an exact formula for the generalization error as a function of reasoning depth, pretraining data amount, and context length. Our analysis reveals a sharp phase transition separating exponential and polynomial improvement, saturation, and overthinking, and characterizes how the optimal reasoning depth scales. We further show that deeper reasoning is most effective with sufficiently rich pretraining and in-context information, whereas limited pretraining or context makes longer reasoning prone to error amplification or saturation. We also validate these predictions through experiments on fully learned linear attention and softmax attention models. Our results provide a unified theoretical account of how test-time CoT depth affects generalization.

    中文

    思维链（CoT）推理已成为一种广泛使用的机制，用于通过在推理时生成中间推理步骤，促使大型语言模型进行多步推理。然而，随着 CoT 深度增加，泛化能力如何变化仍缺乏充分理解。为研究这一问题，我们考察了一个理论上可求解的 CoT 模型：在线性回归中进行上下文内权重预测，其中测试时推理被表示为对权重参数估计的迭代细化。利用高维渐近条件下随机矩阵理论的工具，我们推导出一个精确公式，描述泛化误差如何随推理深度、预训练数据量和上下文长度变化。分析揭示了一个清晰的相变，它区分了指数改进与多项式改进、饱和以及过度思考，并刻画了最优推理深度的缩放规律。我们进一步表明，只有在预训练和上下文内信息足够丰富时，更深的推理才最有效；预训练或上下文有限时，延长推理容易导致误差放大或性能饱和。我们还通过在完全学习得到的线性注意力模型和 softmax 注意力模型上的实验验证了这些预测。我们的结果为测试时 CoT 深度如何影响泛化提供了统一的理论解释。

    DifFRACT: Diffusion Feature Reconstruction and Attribution for Circuit Tracing

    DifFRACT：用于回路追踪的扩散特征重建与归因

    Artyom Mazur, Nina Konovalova and Aibek Alanov

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops feature-level causal attribution for multimodal diffusion transformers and uses intervention-tested graphs to explain how semantic information propagates and features compose, directly advancing mechanistic interpretability and providing substantial insight into attribute binding. Its relevance to reasoning and model systems is incidental because the contribution analyzes generation mechanisms rather than reasoning capabilities or system organization.

    本文为多模态扩散 Transformer 开发特征级因果归因，并使用经干预检验的图解释语义信息如何传播、特征如何组合，直接推进了机制可解释性，并为属性绑定提供了实质性见解。该研究与推理和模型系统的关联只是附带的，因为其贡献在于分析生成机制，而非推理能力或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    While transcoder-based circuit tracing has recently enabled detailed causal analyses of large language models, it remains unclear how semantic information propagates across denoising steps and how text and image representations interact within multimodal diffusion transformers (MM-DiT) for image generation. Attention maps expose only a limited view of token interactions, and sparse autoencoders find interpretable features but do not reveal how nonlinear MLP layers transform and compose them. In this work, we extend transcoder-based circuit tracing to multimodal diffusion transformers. We train timestep-conditioned transcoders that faithfully approximate the input-output behavior of the MLP sublayers in the double-stream blocks of FLUX.1[schnell]. By replacing MLPs with transcoders and linearizing the remaining computation, we obtain exact feature-to-feature attribution and build compact attribution graphs over interpretable features. Empirically, our transcoders match or slightly outperform sparse autoencoders on the sparsity-faithfulness tradeoff. The graphs recover the known shift from prompt-driven to image-driven computation across denoising steps, point to candidate mechanisms of attribute binding and cross-stream semantic propagation, and yield intervention-testable explanations for systematic generation errors. On prompt grids labeled blind, graph-guided interventions reach effects that single-feature steering does not; at a matched budget, features chosen from the graph fix a color prior more often than the target feature alone and destroy the object less often than features chosen by co-activation. FLUX.1[dev] reproduces the temporal and color-prior results, and SD3.5-medium reproduces them in direction. Our results demonstrate that transcoder-based circuit analysis is feasible for state-of-the-art multimodal diffusion transformers.

    中文

    基于 transcoder 的回路追踪近来已能对大型语言模型进行细致的因果分析，但语义信息如何跨去噪步骤传播，以及文本和图像表征如何在用于图像生成的多模态扩散 Transformer（MM-DiT）中相互作用，仍不清楚。注意力图只能展示有限的 token 交互情况；稀疏自编码器能够发现可解释特征，却无法揭示非线性 MLP 层如何变换并组合这些特征。在本研究中，我们将基于 transcoder 的回路追踪扩展到多模态扩散 Transformer。我们训练了按时间步条件化的 transcoder，使其忠实近似 FLUX.1[schnell] 双流块中 MLP 子层的输入输出行为。通过用 transcoder 替换 MLP 并将其余计算线性化，我们获得了精确的特征到特征归因，并围绕可解释特征构建紧凑的归因图。实证结果表明，在稀疏性与忠实度的权衡上，我们的 transcoder 与稀疏自编码器相当，或略胜一筹。这些图重现了去噪过程中从提示词驱动计算向图像驱动计算转变的已知现象，指出了属性绑定和跨流语义传播的候选机制，并为系统性生成错误提供了可通过干预检验的解释。在以盲测方式标注的提示词网格上，图引导干预产生了单特征操控无法达到的效果；在预算相同的条件下，从图中选出的特征比仅用目标特征更常纠正颜色先验，也比依据共激活选出的特征更少破坏物体。FLUX.1[dev] 重现了时间变化和颜色先验方面的结果，SD3.5-medium 则在方向上重现了这些结果。我们的结果表明，基于 transcoder 的回路分析适用于当前最先进的多模态扩散 Transformer。

    LISA: Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Reasoning

    LISA：用于高效长上下文推理的线性索引稀疏注意力

    Yu Zhao, Zekun Zhang, Fan Jiang, Bo Zeng, Xintong Wang, Chonghan Liu, Shimin Shan, Yichao Du, Yu Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LISA introduces gated linear and dynamically selected sparse attention to reduce long-context inference cost while preserving reasoning benchmark quality. This is a core systems contribution in conditional computation and context handling; reasoning is evaluated but the paper focuses on efficient attention rather than reasoning capability or its formation, and teacher-attention imitation alone does not study internal representations.

    LISA 提出将线性注意力与动态选择的稀疏注意力门控融合，以降低长上下文推理成本，同时保持推理基准表现。这是条件计算和上下文处理方面的核心系统贡献；论文评估了推理能力，但重点在于高效注意力，而非推理能力本身或其形成过程；仅模仿教师注意力并不等同于研究内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1 keep lengthening their inference chains under test-time scaling, yet standard self-attention incurs quadratic cost in context length, making long-CoT deployment costly in production. We therefore introduce LISA (Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention), a plug-and-play replacement for self-attention that requires no full pretraining. LISA combines a linear-attention branch for long-range memory with a Lightning Indexer that dynamically selects the most relevant tokens for a sparse self-attention branch. The two branches are fused through a learned gate, so the model retains broad context while focusing computation on informative tokens. We train LISA in two stages. In Stage 1, a linear-attention branch is integrated with sliding-window attention and distilled from a frozen teacher's full-attention distribution. In Stage 2, the Lightning Indexer replaces the static window and is trained with a per-head KL-divergence objective to mimic teacher attention patterns. The resulting model reduces eager-mode self-attention computation from quadratic in sequence length to linear in the number of generated tokens and the selected context budget. Experiments on DeepSeek-distilled Qwen models show that LISA cuts measured eager-mode mean sample latency by 23.9% at 16K context without degrading long-context reasoning quality. Across nine mathematical and code reasoning benchmarks, the gated LISA-1.5B model improves the equal-weight benchmark average by 4.2 percentage points relative to the full-attention baseline.

    中文

    DeepSeek-R1 等长链式思维（CoT）推理模型在测试时扩展过程中不断延长推理链，但标准自注意力的上下文长度开销呈二次增长，导致长 CoT 在生产环境中的部署成本高昂。因此，我们提出 LISA（线性索引稀疏注意力），一种可即插即用的自注意力替代方案，无需完整预训练。LISA 将用于长程记忆的线性注意力分支与 Lightning Indexer 相结合，后者会动态选择最相关的 token，供稀疏自注意力分支使用。两个分支通过一个学习得到的门控机制融合，使模型能够保留广泛上下文，同时将计算集中在信息量较大的 token 上。 我们分两个阶段训练 LISA。第一阶段将线性注意力分支与滑动窗口注意力结合，并根据冻结教师模型的完整注意力分布进行蒸馏。第二阶段用 Lightning Indexer 替换静态窗口，并通过逐头 KL 散度目标进行训练，使其模仿教师模型的注意力模式。由此得到的模型将急切模式下的自注意力计算量，从序列长度的二次复杂度降至生成 token 数与所选上下文预算的线性复杂度。 在经 DeepSeek 蒸馏的 Qwen 模型上的实验表明，在 16K 上下文长度下，LISA 将实测的急切模式平均样本延迟降低了 23.9%，且不损害长上下文推理质量。在九个数学和代码推理基准上，门控式 LISA-1.5B 模型相较于完整注意力基线，将等权基准平均分提高了 4.2 个百分点。

    Bingfan Zeng, Zhisheng Chen, Zhengwei Xie, Bangde Cao, Yuxuan Li, Jinhan Li, Zheng Lu, Xiangchen Guan, Zikai Xiao, Rui Qian, Jingwei Song

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MemPrism's main contribution is a task-conditioned relational memory interface that reorganizes stored agent experience for long-horizon decisions, improving performance and reducing token use. Relational views offer some compositional structure, but the abstract's central advance is agent memory and organization, not composition or internal model interpretation.

    MemPrism 的主要贡献是一种任务条件关系记忆接口，它会为长时程决策重新组织已存储的智能体经验，从而提升性能并减少 token 用量。关系视图提供了一定的组合结构，但摘要的核心进展在于智能体记忆及其组织方式，而非组合性或模型内部解释。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon agents performing multi-step Web tasks must reuse earlier page observations and interactions to support subsequent actions. However, preserving relevant history does not ensure that it exposes the relations needed for the current decision. We call this gap representation mismatch. To this end, we propose MemPrism, a task-conditioned relational memory framework that separates persistent experience storage from decision-time working memory. MemPrism records interactions as the event stream and dynamically constructs relational views according to the current task context. A lightweight view policy selects the relation structure, evidence range, outcome condition, and granularity, while a deterministic composer and renderer transform historical facts into a temporary optical working-memory view for a frozen task policy. Experiments on long-horizon embodied and web-agent benchmarks show that MemPrism consistently improves the task performance, especially as trajectories become longer, while reducing memory token consumption. Furthermore, the learned view policy transfers across different VLMs without additional adaptation, demonstrating the effectiveness of task-conditioned relational views as a general memory interface for agents.

    中文

    执行多步 Web 任务的长时程智能体必须重用先前的页面观察和交互记录，以支持后续行动。然而，保留相关历史并不意味着这些历史会呈现当前决策所需的关系。我们将这一差距称为表征不匹配。为此，我们提出 MemPrism，一种任务条件关系记忆框架，将持久经验存储与决策时工作记忆分离。MemPrism 将交互记录为事件流，并根据当前任务上下文动态构建关系视图。轻量级视图策略选择关系结构、证据范围、结果条件和粒度；确定性的组合器与渲染器则将历史事实转换成临时的光学工作记忆视图，供冻结的任务策略使用。在长时程具身智能体和 Web 智能体基准上的实验表明，MemPrism 能持续提升任务表现，尤其是在轨迹变长时，同时减少记忆 token 消耗。此外，学习得到的视图策略无需额外适配即可迁移到不同的 VLM，表明任务条件关系视图可作为智能体通用记忆接口发挥作用。

    Revenge of Monosemanticity: Neuron Specialization as a New Form of Feature Learning in MLPs

    单义性的回归：神经元特化作为 MLP 中一种新的特征学习形式

    Amirhesam Abedsoltan, Enric Boix-Adsera, Fivos Kalogiannis, Mikhail Belkin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper directly studies feature learning and representation organization, showing that MLP neurons specialize into monosemantic, locally aligned features and proving a data-efficiency advantage. This is core mechanistic and representation-geometry work; clustered inputs and neuron specialization alone do not establish compositional generalization or systems contributions.

    本文直接研究特征学习和表征组织，表明 MLP 神经元会特化为单义且与局部特征对齐的神经元，并证明这种特化带来数据效率优势。这是核心的机制与表征几何研究；仅凭聚类输入和神经元特化，尚不足以证明组合泛化或系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Understanding how neural networks learn and organize features is central to understanding their behavior. Much existing theory of feature learning has focused on the emergence of a global low-dimensional representation. We show that this picture is incomplete. In regression problems with clustered data, we demonstrate that multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) develop specialized neurons: individual neurons become strongly aligned with specific features relevant to a particular region of the input space. A substantial fraction of these neurons exhibit monosemanticity: they activate predominantly on inputs from the corresponding cluster. Thus, rather than learning a single global low-dimensional representation, MLPs learn a collection of local low-dimensional representations. Furthermore, we show that this ability to specialize gives MLPs a provable data-efficiency advantage over feature-learning methods based on a global low-dimensional representation.

    中文

    理解神经网络如何学习和组织特征，是理解其行为的核心。现有许多特征学习理论都聚焦于全局低维表征的涌现。我们表明，这一图景并不完整。在具有聚类数据的回归问题中，我们证明多层感知机（MLP）会形成特化神经元：单个神经元会与输入空间特定区域相关的特征高度对齐。这些神经元中有相当一部分呈现单义性：它们主要在来自相应簇的输入上激活。因此，MLP 学到的不是单一的全局低维表征，而是一组局部低维表征。此外，我们还表明，这种特化能力使 MLP 相较于基于全局低维表征的特征学习方法，具有可证明的数据效率优势。

    Lightning Weave: Improving the Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier of Reasoning Models through Capability Composition

    Lightning Weave：通过能力组合改善推理模型的准确率—效率前沿

    Yecheng Wu, Song Han, Han Cai

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Lightning Weave algorithmically composes capabilities learned by independently post-trained specialists, advancing compositional learning with a concrete method and strong results. Its central contribution directly improves reasoning accuracy and efficiency; reduced need to serve live anchor models is a secondary systems benefit, without a broader systems contribution.

    Lightning Weave 以算法方式组合分别经过后训练的专家模型所学到的能力，通过具体方法和出色结果推进了组合学习。其核心贡献是直接提高推理准确率和效率；减少同时运行在线锚点模型的需求只是次要的系统收益，并未构成更广泛的系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A core goal of efficient reasoning is to improve the accuracy-efficiency frontier. However, jointly improving reasoning accuracy and inference efficiency can be challenging, as the two objectives can favor different reasoning behaviors. Independently post-trained models already offer distinct strengths in accuracy and efficiency. We introduce Lightning Weave, a post-training framework that extracts and composes these independently learned capabilities in a single student through on-policy distillation. Each acquired capability is represented by the policy shift from the model before post-training to the resulting specialist. Lightning Weave combines aligned log-ratio shifts at shared student token states and uses Tilted-Target DOPD to convert the cached signals into a stable learning target. Each anchor pair scores the cached trajectories once, enabling subsequent student training without serving multiple live anchor models concurrently. Across diverse student models and benchmarks in mathematics and code, Lightning Weave substantially improves upon the base students and achieves a state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency frontier. On Qwen3.5-4B, it raises HMMT 2025 accuracy from 59.2% to 64.0% with 10.7% fewer response tokens, and LiveCodeBench v5 accuracy from 41.7% to 54.2% with 9.6% fewer response tokens. Adjusting the relative strengths of the anchor signals yields a strong empirical accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier. These results establish Lightning Weave as a new practical route to efficient reasoning through capability composition. Code is released at https://github.com/jet-ai-projects/Lightning-Weave.

    高效推理的核心目标之一是改善准确率—效率前沿。然而，同时提升推理准确率和推理效率颇具挑战，因为这两个目标可能偏好不同的推理行为。分别经过后训练的模型已经展现出各自在准确率和效率方面的优势。我们提出 Lightning Weave，这是一种后训练框架，通过在策略蒸馏，将这些分别学得的能力提取并组合到单个学生模型中。每项获得的能力都由模型后训练前与训练后成为专家模型之间的策略变化表示。Lightning Weave 在学生模型共享的 token 状态上组合对齐的对数比变化，并使用 Tilted-Target DOPD 将缓存信号转化为稳定的学习目标。每对锚点模型只需对缓存轨迹评分一次，使后续学生训练无需同时运行多个在线锚点模型。在不同学生模型以及数学和代码基准上，Lightning Weave 相较于基础学生模型取得显著提升，并实现了最先进的准确率—效率前沿。在 Qwen3.5-4B 上，它将 HMMT 2025 准确率从 59.2% 提高到 64.0%，同时减少 10.7% 的响应 token；将 LiveCodeBench v5 准确率从 41.7% 提高到 54.2%，同时减少 9.6% 的响应 token。调整锚点信号的相对强度，可以得到强劲的实证准确率—效率帕累托前沿。这些结果确立了 Lightning Weave 是通过能力组合实现高效推理的一条新型实用途径。代码已发布于 https://github.com/jet-ai-projects/Lightning-Weave。

    EvoIn: Bridging Evolution and Internalization for Agent Fine-Tuning

    EvoIn：连接演化与内化的智能体微调框架

    Shihan Dou, Shaofan Liu, Zhonghang Lu, Jiahang Lin, Shichun Liu, Binghai Wang, Jiajie Jin, Guanting Dong, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EvoIn evolves agent decision procedures, converts them into reasoning traces, and fine-tunes models to internalize them; the procedures generalize to unseen tasks. This directly advances training and development of reasoning capabilities, with a substantial agent-system contribution from making improved procedures persist without the harness; trace rewriting alone does not establish a mechanistic account of internal representations.

    EvoIn 演化智能体的决策程序，将其转化为推理轨迹，并微调模型以将这些程序内化；这些程序能够泛化到未见过的任务。这直接推进了推理能力的训练与发展；通过使改进后的程序无需框架也能持续发挥作用，它也对智能体系统作出了实质贡献；但仅凭轨迹改写，并不能建立对内部表征的机制性解释。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent work has explored improving agents by jointly evolving their harnesses and models, but often takes a ''potpourri'' approach that bundles together new tools, new decision-making procedures, and model adaptation to the evolved harness under a single notion of agent improvement. In this paper, we instead investigate how agents can improve their decision-making procedures. In particular, we propose EvoIn, an agent fine-tuning framework that bridges evolution and internalization. EvoIn first analyzes agent execution traces to evolve and validate new decision-making procedures by temporarily instantiating them in the harness. The validated procedures guide the agent to generate improved reasoning traces. These traces are then rewritten into self-contained reasoning traces, removing explicit references to harness instructions while expressing the induced decision logic as the model's own reasoning. Finally, EvoIn fine-tunes the model on the rewritten traces, internalizing these procedures so that the improved decision-making persists without the evolved harness at inference time. We evaluate EvoIn on diverse benchmarks and find that it consistently enables agents to learn stronger decision-making procedures, raising the pass rate by 10.9 points in-domain and by 9.2 points out-of-domain. Results further show that the internalized decision procedures generalize to unseen tasks. Case studies show that agents can learn to decide how to solve a task before solving it, for example by checking a document's length to choose between reading it in full and searching it. EvoIn is also broadly applicable, showing consistent improvements on another model family.

    中文

    近期研究探索了通过共同演化智能体框架和模型来改进智能体，但往往采取一种“大杂烩”式做法，将新工具、新决策程序以及模型对演化后框架的适应一并纳入单一的智能体改进概念。本文转而研究智能体如何改进其决策程序。具体而言，我们提出 EvoIn，这是一种连接演化与内化的智能体微调框架。EvoIn 首先分析智能体执行轨迹，通过在框架中临时实例化新的决策程序来对其进行演化和验证。经验证的程序引导智能体生成改进后的推理轨迹。随后，这些轨迹被改写为自包含的推理轨迹，去除对框架指令的显式引用，同时将由此诱导出的决策逻辑表达为模型自身的推理。最后，EvoIn 使用改写后的轨迹微调模型，将这些程序内化，使改进后的决策能力在推理时无需演化后的框架也能持续发挥作用。我们在多种基准上评估 EvoIn，发现它能持续帮助智能体学到更强的决策程序，使域内通过率提高10.9个百分点，域外通过率提高9.2个百分点。结果还表明，内化的决策程序能够泛化到未见过的任务。案例研究表明，智能体可以学会在解决任务之前先决定如何解决，例如先检查文档长度，再选择通读全文还是进行搜索。EvoIn 也具有广泛适用性，在另一类模型上同样表现出稳定提升。

    Adibvafa Fallahpour, Parsa Idehpour, Vignesh Kothapalli, Nikita Mounier, Shirley Wu, Shayan Pardis, Jure Leskovec

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Memorilla contributes a query-dependent latent memory system that retrieves and places information into a frozen LLM’s input space, with experiments on knowledge access and agent behavior. Its direct focus on memory design and continual use in agents supports a core Systems score; embedding and question-answering performance alone provide only incidental evidence for interpretability, compositionality, or reasoning mechanisms.

    Memorilla 提出一种依赖查询的潜在记忆系统，可检索信息并将其置于冻结 LLM 的输入空间中，并通过知识获取和智能体行为实验进行评估。它直接聚焦于记忆设计及其在智能体中的持续使用，因此在系统方面得分较高；嵌入和问答表现本身对于可解释性、组合能力或推理机制仅提供了附带证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Memory enables large language models (LLMs) to use information beyond their parameters, such as past user conversations, long documents, or an agent's earlier actions. For a frozen LLM, access to this accumulated knowledge is limited to what a memory system places in its context window. However, gathering and combining relevant information needed for each query while keeping the model's context short remains challenging for existing systems. Here we introduce Memorilla, a memory system that gathers information from an entire document collection into a fixed number of query-dependent 'memory tokens' for a frozen LLM. Memorilla encodes documents (such as user chats, book chapters) once into reusable embeddings, then learns to retrieve and place query-specific information in the LLM's input embedding space. Using only 16 memory tokens, Memorilla achieves the best performance against baselines including Mem0 and MemoRAG on five of eight benchmarks spanning personalization, long-document and knowledge-intensive question answering. Notably, on FactKG, it reaches 84.33% accuracy versus 80.43% with full-context inference, while using 108x fewer tokens to represent the source documents. Furthermore, Memorilla can facilitate continual learning in agentic systems where the document count (the agent's past turns) increases throughout the trajectory. In a TextWorld environment, we show that Memorilla reduces the agent's tendency to wander between rooms it has already explored, and improves its average success rate from 18.6% with full-history in-context learning to 24.2%. Overall, Memorilla aids frozen LLMs in accumulating and using knowledge effectively across long-context interactions and takes a step towards building continually learning AI systems.

    中文

    记忆使大型语言模型（LLM）能够使用参数之外的信息，例如过去的用户对话、长篇文档或智能体先前的行动。对于冻结的 LLM，它能访问这些累积知识的范围，取决于记忆系统放入其上下文窗口中的内容。然而，现有系统仍难以在保持模型上下文简短的同时，为每个查询收集并组合所需的相关信息。我们在此介绍 Memorilla，这是一种记忆系统，可将整个文档集合中的信息汇集到固定数量的、依赖查询的“记忆词元”中，供冻结的 LLM 使用。Memorilla 将文档（例如用户聊天、书籍章节）编码为可复用嵌入，此后便无需再次编码；随后它学习检索特定于查询的信息，并将其置于 LLM 的输入嵌入空间中。仅使用 16 个记忆词元时，在涵盖个性化、长文档问答和知识密集型问答的八个基准中，Memorilla 有五个基准的表现优于包括 Mem0 和 MemoRAG 在内的基线。值得注意的是，在 FactKG 上，它的准确率达到 84.33%，而完整上下文推理的准确率为 80.43%；同时，它表示源文档所用的词元数量减少了 108 倍。此外，Memorilla 可支持智能体系统中的持续学习，其中，随着轨迹推进，文档数量（即智能体先前的轮次）不断增加。在 TextWorld 环境中，我们展示了 Memorilla 降低了智能体在已探索房间之间徘徊的倾向，并将其平均成功率从使用完整历史进行上下文内学习时的 18.6% 提高至 24.2%。总体而言，Memorilla 帮助冻结的 LLM 在长上下文交互中有效积累和利用知识，并朝着构建持续学习的 AI 系统迈出了一步。

    Maestro: Agentic Formal Proof Development by Coordination

    Maestro：通过协同开展智能体式形式化证明

    Haoyu Li, Zeren Shui, Yuhao Zhang, Ferhat Erata, Benjamin Mikek, Murali Krishna Ramanathan, Hao Zhou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Maestro coordinates proof agents by diagnosing failures and revising proof plans, with substantial gains on mathematics and software verification benchmarks; this directly advances agentic multi-step reasoning. Its global coordinator and replanning are also a strong model-system contribution, while lemma decomposition alone offers only incidental evidence about compositional generalization.

    Maestro 通过诊断失败原因并修订证明计划来协调证明智能体，在数学和软件验证基准上取得了显著进展；这直接推进了智能体式多步推理。其全局协调器和重新规划也构成了对模型系统的有力贡献，而引理拆分本身只能间接说明其与组合泛化有关。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Lean is increasingly used to verify mathematical proofs and software produced by LLM agents, but writing formal proofs remains hard. Existing prover systems take a divide-and-conquer approach that recursively decomposes hard proof goals into easier lemmas and splits again any lemma that resists proof. However, a lemma can resist proof for different reasons, including insufficient guidance, a false statement, or a flaw in the decomposition that produced it. Existing systems cannot tell these apart as a failed attempt reports little beyond its failure, and responses are confined to the failing node without considering the rest of the proof or revising the plan above it. The system may thus keep decomposing obligations along a flawed proof direction until the budget runs out, causing the whole proof attempt to fail. We introduce Maestro, a Lean prover harness that handles failures through global coordination. Provers report why they failed, not just that they failed, and a coordinator that sees the whole proof chooses an appropriate response, such as guiding a stuck prover, correcting a false lemma, or retracting a flawed subtree and replanning it. The same harness extends to verified code synthesis, where a checked counterexample sends the code back for repair. We evaluate Maestro with four frontier LLMs on seven mathematics and three software verification benchmarks. It proves more targets than each model's native coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) on every benchmark the agent has not already saturated, with the largest gains on research-level mathematics. With Claude Opus 5, it discovers its own proofs of 34 of the 48 theorems in the June 2026 release of arXivLean, against 19 for the native agent. It also outperforms all published prover systems on every benchmark they share, solving 669/672 PutnamBench, 59/60 Lean-IMO-Bench, and 6/6 IMO 2026.

    中文

    Lean 越来越多地用于验证 LLM 智能体生成的数学证明和软件，但编写形式化证明仍然很困难。现有证明器系统采用分治方法，将困难的证明目标递归拆分成更简单的引理，并继续拆分难以证明的引理。然而，引理难以证明可能有不同原因，包括缺少引导、命题为假，或产生该引理的拆分存在缺陷。现有系统无法区分这些情况，因为失败的尝试除了报告失败外几乎没有提供其他信息，而且应对措施仅限于失败节点，不考虑证明的其余部分，也不修改其上层计划。因此，系统可能沿着有缺陷的证明方向不断拆分待证义务，直到预算耗尽，导致整个证明尝试失败。我们提出 Maestro，这是一种通过全局协同处理失败的 Lean 证明器框架。证明器会报告失败的原因，而不只是报告失败；能够查看整个证明的协调器则会选择适当的应对方式，例如引导陷入困境的证明器、纠正错误引理，或撤回有缺陷的子树并重新规划。同一框架还可扩展到经验证的代码合成：经过检查的反例会将代码送回修复。我们使用四种前沿 LLM，在七个数学基准和三个软件验证基准上评估 Maestro。在智能体尚未饱和的每个基准上，它证明的目标都多于各模型原生的编程智能体（Claude Code 或 Codex），且在研究级数学上的增益最大。使用 Claude Opus 5 时，对于 arXivLean 于2026年6月发布的48条定理，Maestro 自行发现了其中34条的证明，而原生智能体为19条。在所有具有共同基准的已发表证明器系统中，它也表现最佳，解出了669/672道 PutnamBench 题、59/60道 Lean-IMO-Bench 题，以及6/6道 IMO 2026 题。

    AOS-Bench：LLM 智能体能否管理动态工作负载？

    Erle Zhu, Genrui Zhang, Keyang Hu, Mingyu Su, Hongning Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a benchmark and empirical analysis of persistent coding agents managing concurrent workloads under CPU and memory limits, identifying task intake and execution policy as important factors. Its connections to reasoning or composition are incidental; the main contribution concerns agent workload management and system organization.

    本文推出一个基准，并实证分析持久运行的编程智能体如何在 CPU 和内存限制下管理并发工作负载，指出任务接收和执行策略是重要因素。它与推理或组合能力的联系只是附带的；主要贡献在于智能体工作负载管理和系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Coding agents are moving from handling one request at a time to serving as persistent assistants to which users hand a stream of work: a build, a data-processing job and a bug fix may all be pending on the same machine at once. Such an agent must decide when to take on new tasks, how to delegate and overlap them, and how to stay within the machine's CPU and memory. Existing benchmarks cannot measure this, because they evaluate each task in isolation. We introduce AOS-Bench, which evaluates an agent system as a workload manager: verified tasks arrive over time and must be delivered under shared CPU and memory limits, and the same tasks run one at a time serve as a per-system reference. Across five model--harness pairs, isolated task success does not carry over evenly. On heavy workloads every system loses 13 to 23 points. On medium workloads, systems span 11 points in isolated success but 26 points in stream success, and two systems 0.6 points apart in isolation deliver 54\% and 68\% of the same tasks. Execution-policy interventions trace much of this gap to task intake: serial dispatch leaves 73\% of heavy-workload tasks unclaimed. Yet more elaborate management does not necessarily help. A fixed concurrency of two comes within four points of the best agent-managed policy on both medium and heavy workloads, and under every policy median CPU use stays below 30\% of the provisioned cores while tasks wait. These results identify workload management as a distinct capability for agents, and AOS-Bench as a way to measure it.

    中文

    编程智能体正从一次处理一个请求，转向充当持久运行的助手，用户会将一连串工作交给它：同一台机器上可能同时有构建任务、数据处理任务和错误修复任务等待处理。此类智能体必须决定何时接手新任务、如何委派并让任务重叠运行，以及如何将资源控制在机器的 CPU 和内存范围内。现有基准无法衡量这一点，因为它们分别评估每项任务。我们推出 AOS-Bench，将智能体系统作为工作负载管理器进行评估：经过验证的任务随时间到达，必须在共享的 CPU 和内存限制下完成；同一批任务逐个运行，则作为每个系统的参照。在五组模型与框架组合中，孤立任务上的成功率并不能均匀地迁移到流式场景。面对重型工作负载时，每个系统的成绩都下降 13 到 23 个百分点。在中等工作负载下，各系统的孤立任务成功率相差 11 个百分点，流式任务成功率却相差 26 个百分点；两个孤立场景成绩仅相差 0.6 个百分点的系统，实际完成的同一批任务比例分别为 54\% 和 68\%。执行策略干预表明，这一差距很大程度上源于任务接收：串行派发导致 73\% 的重型工作负载任务无人认领。然而，更复杂的管理方式未必有帮助。固定并发数为 2 的策略，在中等和重型工作负载下都与最佳智能体管理策略相差不超过 4 个百分点；而在所有策略下，任务等待期间 CPU 使用率中位数始终低于已配置核心数的 30\%。这些结果表明，工作负载管理是智能体的一项独立能力，AOS-Bench 则提供了衡量这种能力的方法。

    Skander Moalla, Ahmad Rammal, Niket Patel, Remi Munos, Julia Kempe

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether a simple agentic loop with verifier feedback and self-reflection can match specialized theorem-proving workflows, finding that an efficient Lean interface is central to performance. This directly advances formal mathematical reasoning (5) and provides strong evidence about agent execution design (4), but does not study internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文检验了带有验证器反馈和自我反思的简单智能体循环能否匹配专用定理证明工作流，并发现高效的 Lean 接口是性能的关键。这直接推进了形式化数学推理（5），也为智能体执行设计（4）提供了有力证据，但没有研究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    While progress in informal mathematics has come largely from scaling the chain-of-thought and agentic reasoning of frontier language models, formal theorem proving has increasingly relied on human-designed workflows around these models, such as planning, decomposition, and orchestrating specialized provers. This raises a bitter-lesson question: can a simple agentic loop that scales test-time compute match these workflows? The answer matters as formal verification must scale to keep up with frontier models producing research mathematics, yet new workflows rarely settle it, as their gains are often confounded with stronger models or more compute. We study this question with h1, a simple harness that gives a model an efficient interface to Lean 4 and keeps it working through verifier feedback and self-reflection, without imposing a decomposition or search structure. h1 reaches state-of-the-art results on PutnamBench, FATE-X, and FormalConjectures100-Solved, settles eight open problems in FormalConjectures, and, at matched models, matches or outperforms specialized workflows such as Goedel-Architect and AlphaProof Nexus, surprisingly showing that a single attempt (pass@1) can often scale to solve open problems. Through ablations and matched-model comparisons with Claude Code and AxProverBase, we find that simplicity alone is not enough: an efficient Lean interface largely determines cost and solve rate. We thus recommend that future work evaluate frontier models with efficient execution feedback before prescribing workflows, at the risk of bitter lessons.

    中文

    非形式化数学的进展很大程度上来自扩展前沿语言模型的思维链和智能体推理能力；而形式化定理证明越来越依赖围绕这些模型由人设计的工作流，例如规划、分解以及编排专用证明器。这引出了一个苦涩教训式的问题：通过扩展测试时计算，一种简单的智能体循环能否达到这些工作流的水平？这个问题很重要，因为形式化验证必须扩展规模，才能跟上产出研究数学成果的前沿模型；然而，新工作流很少能给出定论，因为其收益往往与更强的模型或更多计算量混杂在一起。我们使用 h1 研究这个问题：这是一个简单的工具框架，为模型提供与 Lean 4 高效交互的接口，并通过验证器反馈和自我反思让模型持续工作，同时不强加分解或搜索结构。h1 在 PutnamBench、FATE-X 和 FormalConjectures100-Solved 上取得最先进的结果，解决了 FormalConjectures 中的八个开放问题，并且在匹配模型的条件下，达到或超过 Goedel-Architect 和 AlphaProof Nexus 等专用工作流的表现；令人意外的是，单次尝试（pass@1）往往就能扩展到解决开放问题。通过消融实验以及与 Claude Code 和 AxProverBase 的匹配模型比较，我们发现，仅有简单设计还不够：高效的 Lean 接口在很大程度上决定了成本和求解率。因此，我们建议未来工作在规定工作流之前，先用高效的执行反馈评估前沿模型，以免遭遇苦涩教训。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EMMA 将多智能体配置、路由和程序技能视为结构化情景记忆，并依据诊断出的失败采用范围明确的更新规则和守卫；论文报告了其在多个基准和骨干模型上的性能提升。这是对智能体架构和记忆的核心贡献，而组合与推理是辅助方面，并非研究重点；可解释性仅作为研究动机提及。

    ENGLISH

    Deploying LLM agents in specialized domains often require fine-grained task-specific procedures and knowledge a general model lacks, yet parameter training is costly and non-interpretable, and hand-engineered agent systems shift the cost to expert labor. Episodic memory updates at context level, but single agent adaptation struggles to alleviate cross-task interference, especially with complex tasks such as multi-application navigation or data pool analysis. Although multi-agent evolution alleviates this problem, existing methods lack clear definitions on update rules and rely on the backbone model to decide where and how much the system changes. This ill-scoped evolution makes learning follow the backbone's structural preferences rather than the observed failures: one backbone accumulates skills while another spawns agents. We present EMMA (structured Episodic Memory for Multi-Agent workflow synthesis), which treats the configuration of a multi-agent system (controller routing memory, specialists inheriting a generalist prompt, and per-step procedural skills) as episodic memory. EMMA makes the ownership and admissibility of updates explicit: a reflector assigns each diagnosed failure to the scope owning its correction and proposes one edit within it, and backbone-independent guards keep every accepted edit scoped, incremental and bounded. Across KramaBench, AppWorld and BBEH with five backbones and four baselines (ACE, GEPA, EvoMAS and ADAS), EMMA attains the best overall performance on every benchmark, up to 32.5% over the strongest baseline, maintains consistent improvements across backbones, and uses 17-38% fewer training executions than the most efficient baseline.

    中文

    在专业领域部署 LLM 智能体通常需要细粒度的任务专用流程和知识，而通用模型缺乏这些内容；然而，参数训练成本高且不具可解释性，手工设计智能体系统则把成本转移给专家的人力劳动。情景记忆在上下文层面进行更新，但单智能体适配难以缓解跨任务干扰，尤其是在多应用导航或数据池分析等复杂任务中。尽管多智能体演化能缓解这一问题，现有方法却缺乏对更新规则的明确界定，并依赖骨干模型决定系统在何处以及以多大幅度改变。这种界定不清的演化让学习遵循骨干模型的结构偏好，而非观察到的失败：一种骨干模型会积累技能，另一种则会生成智能体。我们提出 EMMA（用于多智能体工作流合成的结构化情景记忆），将多智能体系统的配置——包括控制器路由记忆、继承通用智能体提示的专用智能体，以及逐步程序技能——视为情景记忆。EMMA 明确规定更新的归属范围与可接受条件：反思器将每个已诊断的失败分配给负责纠正它的范围，并在该范围内提出一项编辑；与骨干模型无关的守卫则确保每项获准编辑都范围明确、渐进且有界。在 KramaBench、AppWorld 和 BBEH 上，使用五种骨干模型并与四种基线（ACE、GEPA、EvoMAS 和 ADAS）比较，EMMA 在每个基准上都取得最佳总体表现，最高比最强基线高 32.5%；它在不同骨干模型上持续取得提升，并且训练执行次数比效率最高的基线少 17–38%。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Fin-SD directly studies how to improve multi-step quantitative reasoning through localized self-distillation, comparing the role of hints and supervision placement. Its frozen teacher and rollout procedure are training components, but the contribution is about reasoning capability rather than model-system organization.

    ENGLISH

    Financial institutions operating under data-residency constraints are restricted to open-weight models small enough to locally host, which trail frontier systems on multi-step quantitative reasoning. On-policy distillation narrows such gaps by supervising a student on its own rollouts, but traditional OPD requires a strong external teacher, and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) conditions on a full reference solution. We ask how much of that signal is necessary. We present Fin-SD, a localized hindsight self-distillation recipe for multi-step reasoning. Given a problem the student fails, the student itself identifies the first incorrect reasoning step and writes a short critique of that step. We truncate the student's trajectory immediately before the error (aiming to obtain a correct prefix), condition a frozen copy of the student on the same prefix plus the hint, and distill that hint-conditioned teacher into the student over a short rollout under reverse KL. No external model contributes a gradient. We apply Fin-SD to GPT-OSS-20B on a custom multi-step financial reasoning benchmark that requires deriving formula inputs from realistic scenarios via accounting conventions. We find: (i) replacing the critique with a generic-feedback control matches Fin-SD's entire 3.03 pp accuracy gain over the base model on the FinanceReasoning Hard subset, suggesting the gain comes from where supervision is applied, not hint content; (ii) the model writing the hint does not need to be stronger than the model receiving it: hints from same-family GPT-OSS-120B, at roughly 6x the parameters, yield no materially greater benefits than self-written hints; and (iii) Fin-SD matches on-policy self-distillation from full reference solutions on accuracy while generating 9.5% fewer tokens.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Stratum proposes persistent, experience-aware repository memory and evaluates its value for coding agents across sessions. Its central contribution directly advances agent memory architecture; repository structure and root-cause identification are application context, not evidence of compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    Stratum 提出持久、能够利用经验的仓库记忆，并评估其对跨会话代码智能体的价值。其核心贡献直接推进了智能体记忆架构；仓库结构和根因识别是应用背景，并非组合泛化或推理机制的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Context windows have grown a thousand-fold, yet coding agents still start every session with no memory of their past work. They re-read files, retry failed approaches, and forget root causes they established hours earlier. This is not a context-length problem but a memory-architecture problem. Our hypothesis: coding agents need persistent, experience-aware repository memory, so that knowledge survives from one session to the next. Three measurements on real repositories motivate the design. First, mid-size projects already exceed the largest production context windows, and storing knowledge inside the model's key-value (KV) cache costs $10^4$ to $10^5$ times more bytes than storing it as indexed text. Second, across 752 real bug-fix commits, the median fix edits two files, and these files plus their direct imports amount to less than 10% of the repository; the bottleneck is selection, not capacity. Third, even with transitive import reachability and test links, 47% of co-edited file pairs remain structurally disconnected; the knowledge needed for selection must be mined from history and experience. We sketch Stratum, a tiered memory that lives with the repository and serves it through page-safe tools: every response states what was returned, what remains, and what it cost. Retrieval over a store of one million nodes takes 1.7 ms at the median. In a multi-session experiment on eight real bugs, a fresh agent that inherited a prior session's memory, written by a different model, identified the root-cause file in 21 of 24 trials versus 6 of 24 for a retrieval-only baseline (Fisher $p<10^{-4}$), at 4.5x lower median token cost. With the notes of all eight investigations pooled in one store, success remained 8/8.

    中文

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Structure predictors like ESMFold fold proteins using neural network computation and have transformed structural biology. However, the driving mechanism from amino-acid (AA) sequence to 3D structure is insufficiently understood, and biological meaning remains locked in the dense network. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have shown promising results in obtaining interpretable concept features over an overcomplete basis of intermediate protein sequence-model representations. Yet folding models, which predict physical shape from AA sequence semantics, have no such account. We hypothesize that the features carrying the folding computation evolve in the 3D structural regression process. In this paper, we interpret the folding trunk in three steps. First, a pilot analysis on the representation distribution across modules and recycles locates distinct spatial computation in the trunk. Second, the dictionaries expose a division of labor: the single representation carries inherited semantics, and the pair representation computes the pairwise geometry. Third, we interpret the dictionary at scale with a reasoning language model, trace how the concepts compose across blocks by gradient-based attribution, and follow the interpreted code to the model's folding output, verifying where the computation aligns with, or departs from, known biochemistry. Together, the sparse dictionaries we train capture the relational geometry the trunk computes beyond the sequence model, and their concept activations forecast the model's own fold quality, turning the black-box folding trunk into a sparse, interpretable, and scientifically verifiable circuit.

    ESMFold 等结构预测器通过神经网络计算折叠蛋白质，推动了结构生物学的发展。然而，从氨基酸（AA）序列到三维结构的驱动机制尚未得到充分理解，生物学含义仍深藏于稠密网络之中。稀疏自编码器（SAE）在过完备基底上获取蛋白质序列模型中间表征的可解释概念特征方面已展现出良好前景。然而，对于根据 AA 序列语义预测物理形状的折叠模型，目前还没有这样的解释。我们假设，承载折叠计算的特征会在三维结构回归过程中发生演化。本文分三步解释折叠主干。第一，通过试点分析各模块和循环过程中的表征分布，定位主干中不同的空间计算。第二，字典揭示了分工：单体表征承载继承而来的语义，成对表征则计算成对几何关系。第三，我们借助推理语言模型大规模解释字典，通过基于梯度的归因追踪概念如何跨模块组合，并将解释后的代码追踪到模型的折叠输出，以验证计算与已知生物化学规律相符或偏离之处。总体而言，我们训练的稀疏字典捕捉了主干在序列模型之外计算的关系几何，其概念激活还能预测模型自身的折叠质量，从而将黑箱折叠主干转化为稀疏、可解释且可通过科学方法验证的电路。

    Donghao Zeng (1), Nishant Subramani (2), Tamar Rott Shaham (3), Benno Krojer (1 and 4) ((1) Mila, McGill University, (2) Carnegie Mellon University, (3) MIT CSAIL, (4) Northeastern University)

    本文通过因果实验检验引导向量能否在图像和文本生成之间迁移，并分析与迁移相关的几何特征，直接探究共享的内部概念与机制。跨模态迁移与组合泛化、推理和系统组织的关系只是附带的；摘要并未研究这些方面。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Are concepts and mechanisms unified across modalities in current AI models, or instead implemented separately for each one? We operationalize this broad question of modality unification by studying cross-modal steering: 1) finding vectors that successfully steer generation on tokens of one modality, which then 2) transfer zero-shot to steer generation when added to tokens of another modality. Our study goes beyond simple correlational alignment (e.g. representational similarity) because steering is fundamentally causal. We study cross-modal steering in several unified multimodal models (UMMs), since they possess shared parameters for language and image generation, focusing on these two modalities. Across diverse steered concepts such as emotion and object size, we show that steering vectors transfer zero-shot in both directions (text-to-image & image-to-text). Even for concepts that are highly unique to one modality (e.g. formal vs. colloquial language), steering vectors often induce a consistent, interpretable effect in the other modality, such as formal clothing and design. This transfer has a geometric signature too: despite a clear modality gap separating text and image representations, steering vectors with strong cross-modal transferability tend to point in similar directions for the same concept. Our findings shed light on how vision and language interact inside unified multimodal models and point towards more general, modality-agnostic approaches for controlling their behavior.

    ENGLISH

    Knowledge distillation from large reasoning models (LRMs) often uses raw teacher trajectories as supervision. However, this practice creates a mismatch between the goal of distillation and the nature of teacher trajectories. Advanced LRMs typically improve their reasoning capabilities through reward-driven post-training, such as RLHF. This training optimizes them as strong solvers, rather than as teachers that produce reasoning processes smaller models can easily learn. Since smaller models have different "cognitive capacities" compared to their larger teachers, directly imitating raw teacher trajectories can sometimes be ineffective and often requires a substantial number of high-quality samples. To bridge this mismatch, we propose Cognition-Aligned Reasoning Distillation (CARD), an RL-based framework that transforms solver trajectories into teaching trajectories aligned with the student's cognition. Avoiding expensive resampling, our framework directly transforms existing trajectories. We optimize CARD with two reward signals: (1) a Distribution Alignment Reward that matches the student's predictive distribution, and (2) a Logical Coherence Reward that reduces misleading failed reasoning steps. Comprehensive evaluations across multiple student models and settings demonstrate that CARD outperforms distillation from raw teacher trajectories in in-domain settings while achieving substantial gains in out-of-distribution performance. Code is available at https://github.com/LiteSSLHub/CARD.

The preference is measured by their logit difference; the prompts prescribe no correct answer. Balanced utility causal selection (BUC) identifies compact head sets by jointly evaluating how much ablating their outputs removes the count effect and how closely patching mean outputs between count conditions recovers the effect in both directions. We derive conditional bounds linking head attribution to intervention effects and specifying when the attribution shortlist can be recovered from finite samples. In Pythia-410M, ablating sets of 1-12 heads selected separately for four ordering regimes removes 65.5-91.6% of the count effect. The sets retain their influence on count comparisons not used for selection. To test relevance beyond symbolic inputs, we evaluate a natural language task asking which state is supported by more reports. Ablating eight heads selected only on symbolic yes/no prompts lowers mean accuracy by 8.2 percentage points, versus 0.8 for random sets matched by size and layer.     ENGLISH

    Diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) process their entire input at every denoising step. Since visual tokens make up 89-97% of this input on the benchmarks we study, most of the decoding computation is spent repeatedly processing the same image. Visual token pruning methods partially relieve this burden by removing part of the visual tokens, but they lose the removed information and still process the remaining image at every step. We therefore propose LOWN, a decoding method that decides at every step whether to process the image and how many tokens to unmask. LOWN predicts the masked tokens without the image and processes the image only when this prediction disagrees with the last image-conditioned prediction. Agreement certifies the earlier prediction for reuse, and the number of certified tokens sets how many are unmasked in that step. We further observe that the need for the image differs across benchmarks, so LOWN's adaptive decision is needed rather than a fixed schedule. Without training or a tuned threshold, LOWN retains 99.6% of LLaDA-V's score on ten benchmarks at 35.3% of the decoding FLOPs on average. LOWN also generalizes across LLaDA-based DVLMs, composes orthogonally with visual token pruning, and runs under key-value caching for further efficiency gains. Code and project page are available at https://hyeon9698.github.io/LOWN/

    中文

    扩散视觉语言模型（DVLM）在每个去噪步骤都会处理全部输入。在我们研究的基准上，视觉词元占输入的 89–97%，因此大部分解码计算都花在反复处理同一图像上。视觉词元剪枝方法通过移除部分视觉词元来减轻这一负担，但会丢失被移除的信息，而且在每一步仍要处理剩余图像。为衡量实际需要图像的频率，我们在每个解码步骤比较 LLaDA-V 有图像和无图像时的预测，发现移除图像仅在平均 22.8% 的步骤中改变了一个待解除掩码的词元，最低甚至只有 7.9%。因此，我们提出 LOWN，这是一种解码方法，可在每一步决定是否处理图像，以及解除多少个词元的掩码。LO​​WN 在不使用图像时预测被掩码的词元，仅当该预测与上一次以图像为条件的预测不一致时才处理图像。一致性可作为证书，确认先前预测可重用；已获证书的词元数量则决定该步骤解除多少个词元的掩码。我们还观察到，不同基准对图像的需求各不相同，因此需要 LOWN 的自适应决策，而非固定调度。在无需训练或调节阈值的情况下，LO​​WN 在十个基准上保留了 LLaDA-V 99.6% 的得分，平均只使用 35.3% 的解码 FLOPs。LO​​WN 还可泛化至基于 LLaDA 的 DVLM，可与视觉词元剪枝正交组合，并能在键值缓存下运行以进一步提升效率。代码和项目页面见 https://hyeon9698.github.io/LOWN/

    CAMR: Compatibility-Aware Memory Replay for Continual Learning in Large Language Models

    CAMR：面向大型语言模型持续学习的兼容性感知记忆回放

    Jingpu Yang, Tianhao Li, Fengxian Ji, Yufeng Wang, Shuxin Zheng, Xiaoqing Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CAMR uses a learned gate and bounded replay policy to manage knowledge acquisition, retention, and training cost in continual learning, making memory organization its central contribution. Its cross-task evaluations touch composition and mathematical reasoning only as settings, without directly studying compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    CAMR 利用学习得到的门控和有上限的回放策略，在持续学习中管理知识获取、保留和训练成本，因此记忆组织是其核心贡献。其跨任务评估涉及组合性和数学推理，但这只是应用场景，并未直接研究组合泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Continual learning requires large language models to acquire new knowledge and capabilities while retaining what they have learned. Fine-tuning and replay support acquisition and retention, but deciding whether incoming examples need supervision and which historical examples to revisit remains a challenge. We propose Compatibility-Aware Memory Replay (CAMR), an adaptive framework that jointly controls current-example supervision and historical replay. CAMR combines compatibility checks with a learned memory gate to guide an online policy over three actions: learning incoming examples with general replay, jointly reinforcing compatible related examples, and skipping direct supervision of verified mastered duplicates. The policy learns from acquisition, retention, and training-cost feedback under a bounded per-arrival replay budget. We evaluate CAMR with Qwen3-8B-Base on continual factual updating and cross-task and cross-domain learning. On WikiBigEdit, CAMR consistently leads evaluated methods in Original Match from 3K to 100K facts, reaching 93.66% after just 3K facts and surpassing Full-history Replay (LoRA) after 100K facts. It also achieves the highest final scores on all four selected TRACE tasks and maintains or improves earlier-task performance relative to post-acquisition levels in a sequence spanning financial question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and summarization.

    中文

    持续学习要求大型语言模型在获取新知识和能力的同时保留已学内容。微调和回放有助于知识获取与保留，但仍面临挑战：如何判断新输入样例是否需要监督，以及应重新访问哪些历史样例。我们提出兼容性感知记忆回放（CAMR），这是一种自适应框架，可联合控制当前样例监督与历史回放。CAMR 将兼容性检查与学习得到的记忆门控相结合，以引导在线策略在三种动作间选择：通过一般回放学习新输入样例；联合强化兼容且相关的样例；跳过对已验证掌握的重复样例进行直接监督。该策略在每个样例到达时受限的回放预算下，根据知识获取、保留和训练成本反馈进行学习。我们使用 Qwen3-8B-Base 在持续事实更新、跨任务学习和跨领域学习上评估 CAMR。在 WikiBigEdit 上，从 3K 到 100K 条事实的范围内，CAMR 的 Original Match 始终领先于受评估的方法；仅处理 3K 条事实后就达到 93.66%，在处理 100K 条事实后则超过 Full-history Replay（LoRA）。它在选定的全部四项 TRACE 任务上也取得最高最终得分，并且在涵盖金融问答、数学推理、代码生成和摘要的序列中，相对于获取新知识后的水平，维持或提升了早期任务表现。

    Xiang Ding

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses activation patching to identify distinct state-based mechanisms for lingering abandoned parses and adaptation after disambiguation, directly explaining how model representations drive later behavior. Garden-path comprehension is relevant to reasoning only indirectly; the contribution does not study compositional generalization or model and agent systems.

    本文使用激活修补识别出不同的基于状态的机制，解释已放弃句法分析的持续影响以及消歧后的适应，直接说明模型表示如何驱动后续行为。花园路径句理解与推理只有间接关联；本文没有研究组合泛化或模型与智能体系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reading "While the man hunted the deer ran into the woods" requires giving up the analysis in which "the deer" is the object of "hunted". People who have just read such a sentence still produce more transitive structures, so the abandoned analysis primes later language. We ask whether language models keep using an analysis they have abandoned, and what in the model carries it. In 24 open models from 124M to 70B parameters, a garden-path sentence leaves two traces in the context. A residue of the abandoned analysis raises later object attachment, by about three quarters of the effect of a sentence in which the noun phrase really is an object, and it appears in sampled text, on held-out and human-normed items and for a second type of garden path. An adaptation toward the resolved structure scales with the sentence's disambiguation error and acts mainly on comprehension-like measures. Activation patching separates the two. Later text reads the residue from the role information in the noun phrase's states, which were computed under the object analysis before the disambiguation, and replacing these states removes almost all of the residue in the 32B and 70B models. The adaptation is read from the states that processed the disambiguation. Overridden statements show the same persistence (a corrected value keeps pulling later predictions in 8 of 9 models), and in most models the pull is carried by the positions after the statement. Finally, the human paradigm transfers only with controls for punctuation, because the models also write garden-path sentences themselves, which reverses the paradigm's raw statistic.

    中文

    阅读“While the man hunted the deer ran into the woods”（当这个人打猎时，鹿跑进了树林）需要放弃“the deer”是“hunted”的宾语这一分析。刚读完这类句子的人仍会生成更多及物结构，因此已放弃的分析会对之后的语言产生启动作用。我们探究语言模型是否会继续使用已经放弃的分析，以及模型中的哪些部分承载着它。在 124M 到 70B 参数的 24 个开放模型中，一个花园路径句会在上下文中留下两种痕迹。已放弃分析的残留会提高之后宾语附着的概率，其效应约为名词短语确实是宾语的句子所产生效应的四分之三；在采样文本、留出且经过人类常模评定的项目以及第二种花园路径类型中，都能观察到这种现象。朝已解析结构方向的适应会随句子的消歧错误而增强，并主要作用于类似理解的测量指标。激活修补将两者区分开来。后续文本从名词短语状态中的角色信息读取这一残留；这些状态是在消歧之前、按宾语分析计算出来的。在 32B 和 70B 模型中，替换这些状态几乎可以消除全部残留。适应则从处理消歧内容的状态中读取。被更正的陈述也表现出同样的持续性（更正后的数值仍会持续影响后续预测，在 9 个模型中的 8 个如此），而在大多数模型中，这种影响由陈述之后的位置承载。最后，只有在控制标点的情况下，人类实验范式才能迁移，因为模型自身也会写出花园路径句，这会逆转该范式的原始统计结果。

    当所有采样轨迹都失败时：面向难题推理的策略兼容联合解码

    Zehao Wang, Hanzhu Chen, Runquan Gui, Zhe Wang, Lin Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PICO directly addresses the learning failure of RLVR on hard reasoning problems, proposing policy-compatible joint decoding and a mixed-behavior training objective to produce transferable reasoning updates. Agentic benchmarks are an evaluation setting, while the abstract does not present a substantive agent-system contribution.

    PICO 直接应对 RLVR 在难题推理上的学习失败，提出策略兼容联合解码和混合行为训练目标，以产生可迁移的推理更新。智能体基准只是评估场景，摘要并未提出实质性的智能体系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) derives its learning signal from binary rewards via on-policy exploration and becomes a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning of large language models. Yet it faces a learning cliff on problems beyond model's current ability: when every rollout fails, the samples reveal nothing about a correct solution, and group-relative estimators (e.g., GRPO, RLOO) collapse the update to zero advantage. Expert trajectories offer a remedy, but they are incompatible with the current policy and often lie in the student's low-probability regions, so the surviving updates demand large parameter shifts and decay into surface-level imitation rather than transferable reasoning. We argue that a useful learning signal on hard problems must be both verifiably correct and sufficiently compatible with the current policy. We propose Policy-Compatible Reinforcement Learning (PICO), which performs distribution-constrained joint decoding: expert data guides decoding at the token level while preserving the student's relative token probabilities, and a dynamic top-k mechanism confines the sampling distribution under a finite divergence budget, yielding trajectories that are verified and policy-compatible by construction. These trajectories are optimized jointly with on-policy rollouts under a mixed-behavior objective that mitigates their distribution mismatch via importance sampling. Experiments across reasoning diverse datasets and agentic benchmarks demonstrate that PICO consistently outperforms standard RLVR and prior off-policy baselines.

    中文

    基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通过在线策略探索从二元奖励中获取学习信号，已成为提升大型语言模型推理能力的有力范式。然而，对于超出模型当前能力的问题，它会遭遇学习断崖：当所有采样轨迹都失败时，样本无法揭示任何正确解法，而组相对估计器（例如 GRPO、RLOO）会使更新的优势值降为零。专家轨迹提供了一种补救方法，但它们与当前策略不兼容，并且往往处于学生模型的低概率区域，因此保留下来的更新需要大幅调整参数，最终退化为表层模仿，而非可迁移的推理。我们认为，难题上的有效学习信号必须同时具备可验证的正确性，并与当前策略充分兼容。我们提出策略兼容强化学习（PICO），通过受分布约束的联合解码实现这一目标：专家数据在 token 级别引导解码，同时保留学生模型的相对 token 概率；动态 top-k 机制则在有限散度预算下约束采样分布，从而以构造方式生成经过验证且与策略兼容的轨迹。这些轨迹与在线策略采样轨迹一起，在混合行为目标下联合优化，并通过重要性采样缓解分布不匹配。在多种推理数据集和智能体基准上的实验表明，PICO 始终优于标准 RLVR 和先前的离线策略基线。

    HiLo-RD：面向掩码扩散语言模型的跨预算自蒸馏

    Xiang Li, Chengting Yu, Jungang Li, Yilun Zheng, Junzhuo Li, Xingyao Zhang, Wenbo Su, Xuming Hu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HiLo-RD transfers hidden representations from large-window to small-window masked diffusion decoding, and diagnostics and interventions support its account of premature commitment redirecting later reasoning. It strongly advances reasoning and representation mechanisms; its central focus on commitment order under constrained generation also makes a substantial contribution to adaptive computation.

    HiLo-RD 将大窗口表征迁移到小窗口掩码扩散解码中，诊断和干预实验支持其关于过早确定会改变后续推理方向的解释。它显著推进了推理与表征机制研究；其核心关注点是在生成受限时控制确定顺序，因此也对自适应计算作出了重要贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We propose HiLo-RD (High-to-Low Budget Representation Distillation) to improve masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) under a limited generation budget. Unlike autoregressive models, MDLMs choose both what to generate and where to commit it. This creates two coupled challenges: predicting useful content before reasoning is complete, and deciding when to fix answer tokens that shape later predictions. We identify budget-induced premature commitment: even when a correct solution fits, the model can fix answer fragments near the window boundary before resolving intermediate steps. These fragments become context for later predictions and redirect subsequent reasoning. Existing post-training methods do not directly transfer the stronger trajectories that the same model follows with a larger window. HiLo-RD addresses this gap by (1) pairing large-window teacher states with cropped small-window views and (2) matching their hidden representations at committed positions. This supervision guides both token prediction and commitment order without an external teacher. Across mathematics benchmarks, HiLo-RD improves low-budget accuracy and shortens responses; these gains extend to code generation without code-domain training. On GSM8K, accuracy rises by 9.4 percentage points as mean readable length falls by about 25%. Attention diagnostics and fixed-budget order interventions support the proposed mechanism. Together, these results show that large-window reasoning can improve small-window decoding.

    中文

    我们提出 HiLo-RD（高预算到低预算表征蒸馏），以在生成预算有限时提升掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）的表现。与自回归模型不同，MDLM 既要选择生成什么，也要决定何时将其确定下来。这带来两个相互关联的挑战：在推理尚未完成前预测有用内容，以及决定何时固定会影响后续预测的答案 token。我们发现了预算诱发的过早确定现象：即使正确解答在窗口范围内，模型仍可能在解决中间步骤前，就固定窗口边界附近的答案片段。这些片段会成为后续预测的上下文，并改变接下来的推理方向。现有后训练方法无法直接迁移同一模型在更大窗口下生成的更强轨迹。HiLo-RD 通过以下方式弥补这一缺口：(1) 将大窗口教师状态与裁剪后的小窗口视图配对；(2) 匹配它们在已确定位置上的隐藏表征。这种监督在无需外部教师的情况下，同时引导 token 预测和确定顺序。在多个数学基准上，HiLo-RD 提升了低预算准确率并缩短了回答；无需代码领域训练，这些收益也延伸到了代码生成。在 GSM8K 上，准确率提高了 9.4 个百分点，而平均可读长度缩短了约 25%。注意力诊断和固定预算下的顺序干预支持本文提出的机制。总之，这些结果表明，大窗口推理能够改善小窗口解码。

    Nabeelah Faumi, Deshan Sumanathilaka

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The pruning study uses causal circuit analyses to show that output quality can conceal major changes to internal computation, including sign inversion in a known circuit.     这项剪枝研究运用因果电路分析表明，输出质量可能掩盖内部计算的重大变化，包括已知电路中的符号反转。这直接推动了机制可解释性研究；推理和系统只是评估剪枝时的背景，并未对推理或系统设计作出实质贡献。

    ENGLISH

    Pruned language models are judged almost entirely by accuracy and perplexity, which assumes that preserved output behaviour implies preserved internal computation. We test this assumption with a factorial pruning study on GPT-2, crossing two importance criteria (magnitude, random), two component types (attention heads, MLP neurons) and three sparsity levels (3%, 50%, 70%). Using the fully characterised indirect object identification (IOI) circuit as ground truth, we measure circuit integrity with activation patching, path patching and direct logit attribution. We find two qualitatively distinct failure modes. Magnitude head pruning >= zeroes the circuit: output-facing heads are removed, and the model falls to near-chance. Magnitude neuron pruning at 30% inverts it: all 26 circuit heads remain intact, but Name Mover contributions flip sign, and the model systematically prefers the wrong name (17.7% accuracy). Perplexity ranks it as less damaged than random head pruning (74.6 vs 140.1). A replication of the Greater-Than circuit shows that the critical component type depends on the circuit's architecture.     Jiawei Zhou, Bo Peng, Yuxuan Huang, Ming Zhang, Youbang Sun, Xiang Wang, Chaochao Lu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    BiPA tests whether skill edits truly improve agent performance and traces their added-turn and token costs, yielding transferable evaluation and optimization principles for agent systems. Its long-horizon tasks involve problem solving, but the abstract does not study reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    BiPA 检验技能修改是否真正提升智能体表现，并追踪其增加的轮次和 token 成本，从而为智能体系统提供可迁移的评估和优化原则。这些长时域任务涉及问题求解，但摘要没有研究推理机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Skill optimizers adapt an agent to long-horizon tasks, such as repairing a terminal environment, by rewriting its skill, a natural-language procedure in its context, and keeping the edits that raise success on a small dev set. On such tasks success is noisy, so a gain on a small dev set does not show that an edit helps, and a success score does not show what the edit costs. We introduce BiPA, which replays an optimizer's acceptance rule on candidates identical to its seed to measure what selection alone reports, and records each episode as a bipartite graph of turns and the text they read to trace extra input tokens to the behavior behind them. Across three optimizers, three agentic benchmarks and two models, the learned skills succeed about as often as their hand-written seed, 0.1 points higher on average. Their dev gains vanish on test: keeping the best of several candidates on at most 30 tasks reports gains this large even when none changed. They read about 16% more input tokens: the optimizers almost always add rules, half to re-check work and some to act one call at a time, and the agent follows them as extra turns, each re-sending the whole conversation. Four principles follow: accept an edit only if its gain exceeds what selection alone reports; charge it for the turns it adds, not for its length; let the editor delete and merge rules; show it what earlier rules cost. Code is available at https://github.com/valleysprings/BiPA.git.

    从感知不确定性坍塌视角揭示视频 RLVR 中的捷径放大

    Jiafeng Liang, Xianhao Ou, Tao Ren, Rongchuan Mu, Runxuan Liu, Dandan Tu, Ming Liu, See-Kiong Ng, Bing Qin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes how video RLVR amplifies text-prior shortcuts as visual uncertainty collapses, then proposes training updates to preserve visually grounded, reasoning-sensitive behavior. Its training-dynamics and gradient analysis offers partial mechanistic insight, while the policy optimization does not substantially address agent or computation-system design.

    本文分析视频 RLVR 如何随着视觉不确定性坍塌而放大文本先验捷径，并提出训练更新方法，以保留有视觉依据且对推理敏感的行为。其对训练动态和梯度的分析提供了部分机制层面的洞见，而策略优化并未实质涉及智能体或计算系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for enhancing the video reasoning capability of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). Despite its empirical effectiveness, we show that outcome-level optimization can introduce an undesirable shortcut amplification effect, whereby models increasingly favor text-prior answers even when they are not supported by the visual evidence. To characterize this behavior, we investigate the training dynamics of video RLVR through the lens of perceptual uncertainty, analyzing how predictive uncertainty evolves under video-conditioned and text-only contexts. Our analysis identifies a perceptual uncertainty collapse phenomenon, in which RL training continuously sharpens the model's answer distribution while the uncertainty reduction attributable to visual evidence progressively diminishes. A further gradient-direction analysis reveals that such confidence enhancement becomes increasingly less aligned with visually grounded uncertainty reduction and is instead dominated by text-prior compression. Motivated by these findings, we propose Bifocal Self-distillation Policy Optimization (BSPO), a self-distillation framework that regulates policy updates with two complementary distributional signals. Specifically, BSPO derives empirical reasoning principles from intra-group correct and incorrect rollouts to identify reasoning-sensitive tokens, and introduces shortcut-aware visual perturbation to penalize predictions that remain invariant when task-relevant visual evidence is weakened. By adaptively reweighting the original RL advantage, BSPO preserves the task-solving benefits of RLVR while promoting updates that are both reasoning-sensitive and visually grounded. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of BSPO in improving video reasoning performance and strengthening visual faithfulness.

    中文

    带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为一种有效的后训练范式，可增强大型多模态模型（LMM）的视觉推理能力。尽管这种方法在经验上有效，我们发现，结果层面的优化可能引发不良的捷径放大效应：即使文本先验给出的答案缺乏视觉证据支持，模型也会越来越倾向于选择这类答案。为刻画这一行为，我们从感知不确定性的角度研究视频 RLVR 的训练动态，分析预测不确定性在视频条件上下文和纯文本上下文中的变化。我们的分析发现了感知不确定性坍塌现象：RL 训练不断使模型的答案分布变得更加尖锐，而视觉证据带来的不确定性降低却逐渐减弱。进一步的梯度方向分析表明，这种置信度提升与基于视觉的真实不确定性降低越来越不一致，反而主要由文本先验压缩所驱动。受这些发现启发，我们提出双焦点自蒸馏策略优化（BSPO），这是一种使用两种互补分布信号调节策略更新的自蒸馏框架。具体而言，BSPO 从组内正确和错误 rollout 中提取经验推理原则，以识别对推理敏感的 token，并引入具备捷径意识的视觉扰动，对任务相关视觉证据被削弱时预测仍保持不变的情况进行惩罚。通过自适应地重新加权原始 RL 优势，BSPO 在保留 RLVR 解决任务益处的同时，推动兼具推理敏感性和视觉依据的更新。大量实验验证了 BSPO 在提升视频推理性能和增强视觉忠实度方面的有效性。
