    Let the Gate Decide: Per-Lookup Precision for Quantized Conditional Memory in LLMs

    让门控决定：面向 LLM 量化条件记忆的逐次查找精度

    Tianqi Chen, Xunchao Li, Linchuan Xie, Guanghua Yu, Jianchen Zhu, Peisong Wang, Jian Cheng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    GateRQ uses gate-weighted quantization error to allocate memory reads adaptively for conditional memory, substantially improving storage and throughput. This advances memory and computation design, but the abstract offers no substantive insight into internal representations, composition, or reasoning.

    GateRQ 利用受门控值加权的量化误差，为条件记忆自适应分配内存读取，从而显著改善存储占用和吞吐量。这推进了内存与计算设计，但摘要没有提供关于内部表征、组合或推理的实质性见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Conditional memory layers, such as DeepSeek's Engram, attach large hashed n-gram tables to a language model, and removing them from DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash costs 36.8 PopQA points. Low-bit quantization loses long-tail facts first, and the standard remedy, giving more bits to frequently accessed rows, backfires: refining lookups by access frequency is worse than refining them at random. We trace this to the gate that scales each retrieved row. A lookup's quantization error is weighted by its gate, which is small for frequent n-grams, large for the rare n-grams of long-tail entities, and computable from a 1-bit code. GateRQ therefore stores each row as a ladder of 1-bit residual codes, keeps level 1 in GPU memory to compute the gate, and reads deeper levels only for the lookups the gate ranks highest. Without retraining, GateRQ cuts GPU table memory by 7.8x on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, which raises vLLM throughput by 11%-31% over FP8 tables, while losing about 1 PopQA point at 1.50 bits read per lookup and 0.2 points at 2.10 bits across two models.

    中文

    条件记忆层（例如 DeepSeek 的 Engram）会将大型哈希 n-gram 表附加到语言模型上；从 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 中移除这些记忆会导致 PopQA 得分下降 36.8 分。低比特量化会首先丢失长尾事实，而常见补救办法——为高频访问的行分配更多比特——适得其反：按访问频率精细化查找结果，比随机精细化的效果更差。我们将这一现象追溯到对每个检索行进行缩放的门控。查找的量化误差会受到其门控值的加权；对于高频 n-gram，门控值较小，而对于长尾实体中的稀有 n-gram，门控值较大，并且可以通过 1 比特代码计算。因而，GateRQ 将每一行存储为一组阶梯式的 1 比特残差代码，把第 1 层保存在 GPU 内存中以计算门控值，并且只为门控评分最高的查找读取更深层。无需重新训练，GateRQ 就能将 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的 GPU 表内存减少 7.8 倍，使 vLLM 相较于 FP8 表的吞吐量提高 11%–31%；在两个模型上，每次查找读取 1.50 比特时 PopQA 得分约下降 1 分，读取 2.10 比特时下降 0.2 分。

    逐层重打包：无需额外重分发遍次的变长混合注意力训练

    Jiahao Zhang, Junwei Feng, Dongliang Huang, Xiaoling Zhou, Yiqiao Liao, Chengru Song

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Layerwise Repacking combines sample redistribution with existing communication steps to improve training efficiency for hybrid-attention models, a substantial systems contribution. Attention and MoE are architectural context here; the abstract provides no substantive contribution to interpretability, compositionality, or reasoning.

    逐层重打包将样本重分发与现有通信步骤结合起来，提高混合注意力模型的训练效率，是一项重要的系统贡献。注意力和 MoE 在这里是架构背景；摘要没有提供有关可解释性、组合性或推理的实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Variable-length training creates conflicting parallelism requirements across the layers of a hybrid-attention model. The longest samples require wide sequence-parallel (SP) groups of 16 or 32 ranks for full attention, whose cost grows quadratically with sequence length. Sparse-attention layers, dominated by near-linear MoE work, can instead balance most evaluated workloads within node-local SP8 groups. Reusing the wide groups for these layers pushes their all-to-all communication across nodes, where the observed effective rate is 7.0x lower. Yet switching to smaller groups changes which ranks own each sample; a separate redistribution at every full-sparse boundary would introduce another data transfer. Layerwise Repacking keeps each SP16/32 parent for full attention and repacks its samples into node-local sparse children at SP{1, 2, 4, 8}, where hidden states persist between full layers. The layout change rides on the two existing full-layer Ulysses sites: at each, one variable-size all-to-all performs both the head exchange and the sample repacking, so no redistribution pass is added. Because the balance the children can reach depends on which samples share a parent, an auxiliary parent solver rebalances parent membership before the children are formed. On all 22 steps with SP16/32 parents among the first 200 training steps of a 1F3S hybrid-attention model (one full-attention layer per three sparse-attention layers), repacking alone reduces the mean end-to-end time by 5.95% and raises model FLOPs utilization (MFU) by 3.75 percentage points over the baseline with repacking disabled; with the improved solver, end-to-end time falls by 7.61% and MFU rises by 4.83 percentage points.

    中文

    变长训练会使混合注意力模型不同层的并行需求相互冲突。最长样本需要由 16 或 32 个 rank 组成的宽序列并行（SP）组来执行全注意力，其开销随序列长度呈平方增长。以近线性 MoE 计算为主的稀疏注意力层，则可以在节点本地的 SP8 组内平衡大多数已评估的工作负载。若这些层沿用宽组，其全互联通信就会跨节点进行，而观测到的有效速率会低 7.0 倍。然而，切换到较小的组会改变各样本由哪些 rank 持有；在每个全注意力与稀疏注意力的边界单独执行重分发，又会引入一次数据传输。逐层重打包为全注意力保留每个 SP16/32 父组，并将其中的样本重新打包到节点本地、并行度为 SP{1, 2, 4, 8} 的稀疏子组中；在全注意力层之间，隐藏状态会持续保留。布局变更借助两个现有的全注意力层 Ulysses 位置完成：每处都通过一次可变大小的全互联同时执行头部交换和样本重打包，因此无需增加重分发遍次。由于子组能够达到的负载平衡程度取决于哪些样本共享同一父组，辅助父组求解器会在生成子组之前重新平衡父组成员分配。在某个 1F3S 混合注意力模型（每三个稀疏注意力层配一个全注意力层）的前 200 个训练步骤中，所有包含 SP16/32 父组的 22 个步骤都进行了评估；仅重打包就使端到端平均耗时相较于关闭重打包的基线降低了 5.95%，并使模型 FLOPs 利用率（MFU）提高了 3.75 个百分点；使用改进后的求解器时，端到端耗时降低 7.61%，MFU 提高 4.83 个百分点。

    ENGLISH

    Sparse expert execution does not remove the stored states needed to adapt a mixture-of-experts language model. We present DuplexTune, a framework for replaying coupled hidden states through pretrained attention and expert modules. Trainable width bridges connect two residual streams to the backbone. Bridge warm-up precedes backbone adaptation, with router weights kept frozen. We analyze the implicit state-recovery equation and identify the convergence and replay conditions needed for reconstruction. On Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, the single-H800 evaluation reports 38.8 GB peak memory, versus 64.8 GB for supervised fine-tuning with checkpointing, and throughput of 25.1 versus 19.9 samples/s. DuplexTune achieves 67.2% MMLU, 75.6% GSM8K, and 7.69 MT-Bench, with a weaker multilingual score than the checkpointed baseline.     OmniBrain-0 trains a compact embodied agent to coordinate manipulation and navigation through planning, progress tracking, recovery, and distillation of interaction experience, with a recursive data-improvement process.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    General-purpose embodied intelligence requires robots to coordinate diverse skills over long horizons, track task progress, and recover from failures. Specialist policies alone do not ensure task-level reliability, while powerful multimodal agents rely on costly reasoning and external experience that compact models struggle to reproduce. We introduce OmniBrain-0, a lightweight unified embodied agent that coordinates manipulation and navigation through a shared high-level decision model, integrating task understanding, planning, progress tracking, and feedback-driven recovery. Our progressive training framework combines embodied pretraining, domain-specialized agent distillation, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). It distills powerful teachers' interaction experience into manipulation and navigation experts, then consolidates their decision capabilities into OmniBrain-0. Unification therefore occurs within the learned decision model rather than only at the tool interface. We further introduce Rubric-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), a data flywheel in which a Meta-Agent turns execution evidence into refined rubrics, step-level reminders, and verified trajectories for domain-expert updates before their reconsolidation into OmniBrain-0 through MOPD. We evaluate OmniBrain-0 on LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, RoboCasa365, RoboTwin 2.0, and R2R-CE Val-Unseen, as well as multiple real-world manipulation tasks. OmniBrain-0 combines strong cross-domain task performance with substantially lower inference and execution overhead than its closed-source teacher, demonstrating efficient transfer and consolidation of embodied capabilities into a compact unified agent.

    中文

    通用具身智能要求机器人能够在长时间跨度内协调多种技能、跟踪任务进度并从失败中恢复。仅靠专家策略无法确保任务层面的可靠性，而强大的多模态智能体依赖成本高昂的推理和外部经验，紧凑模型难以复现这些能力。我们提出 OmniBrain-0，这是一种轻量级统一具身智能体，通过共享的高层决策模型协调操作与导航，并整合任务理解、规划、进度跟踪以及由反馈驱动的恢复能力。我们的渐进式训练框架结合了具身预训练、领域专用智能体蒸馏和多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）。该框架将强大教师的交互经验蒸馏到操作和导航专家中，再将它们的决策能力整合到 OmniBrain-0 中。因此，统一发生在学习到的决策模型内部，而不只是在工具接口层面。我们还提出准则引导的递归自我改进（RSI）：在这一数据飞轮中，元智能体将执行证据转化为经过改进的准则、步骤级提醒和经过验证的轨迹，用于更新领域专家，之后再通过 MOPD 将其重新整合到 OmniBrain-0 中。我们在 LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa365、RoboTwin 2.0 和 R2R-CE Val-Unseen 上评估 OmniBrain-0，并评估了多个真实世界的操作任务。OmniBrain-0 在跨领域任务中表现出色，同时其推理和执行开销远低于闭源教师，展示了将具身能力高效迁移并整合到紧凑型统一智能体中的效果。

    Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement

    Rollback：在世界模型中回溯经验以改进策略

    Jiayi Luo, Yang Zhang, Liliang Chen, Nan Wang, Chen Gao, Boxiang Qiu, Zhuoxuan Li, Baorui Peng, Chuankang Li, Yuxiang Yan, Si Liu, Qingyun Sun, Shuicheng Yan, Maoqing Yao, Jianxin Li, Guanghui Ren

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Rollback uses world-model backtracking to compare counterfactual actions and provide fine-grained supervision for policy improvement, with real-robot results. This substantially advances planning and action-level learning, while its distributed training and model-update pipeline offer a secondary systems contribution without a general systems mechanism.

    Rollback 利用世界模型回溯来比较反事实动作，并为策略改进提供细粒度监督，同时报告了真实机器人的实验结果。这项工作显著推进了规划和动作级学习；其分布式训练和模型更新流程则带来次要的系统贡献，但没有提出通用的系统机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Action-conditioned world models offer a scalable alternative to costly real-world interaction for improving robot policies. However, existing world-model-based methods largely treat world models as forward-only surrogates of the physical environment, leaving untapped a capability no physical environment affords: rewinding to past decision points to explore counterfactual futures. We introduce Rollback, a policy improvement paradigm that turns world models from passive simulators into counterfactual engines: it rolls back to critical decision points, branches into alternative actions, and contrasts their outcomes to attribute success to individual decisions. This concentrates imagination where it matters most and distills counterfactual outcomes into fine-grained, action-level supervision without a separately learned value model. We build a scalable training system that unifies distributed world-model search with asynchronous real-robot execution, forming a self-reinforcing cycle: real-world experience continually sharpens the world model, and a sharper world model in turn drives further policy improvement. We term the world-model side of this cycle test-time physics grounding, a capability that hand-built physics simulators lack: while the world model serves as the training environment, real transitions from the policy it trains correct its dynamics through a lightweight LoRA pipeline. Experiments on three challenging real-world tasks show that Rollback improves success rates over the strongest baseline by an absolute 10.67%, 11.11%, and 11.85% on block extraction, ball tossing, and tabletop curling, respectively, while achieving more stable improvement throughout training. Although initialized from teleoperated demonstrations far below human level, Rollback surpasses the average success rate of human players on both ball tossing and tabletop curling within 8 hours of training.

    中文

    以动作为条件的世界模型为改进机器人策略提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，避免了成本高昂的真实世界交互。然而，现有基于世界模型的方法大多将世界模型视为物理环境的单向前向代理，未能利用一种物理环境无法提供的能力：回到过去的决策点，探索反事实的未来。我们提出 Rollback，这是一种策略改进范式，它将世界模型从被动模拟器转变为反事实引擎：回溯到关键决策点，分支尝试其他动作，并对比结果，以便将成功归因于具体决策。该方法将想象集中在最关键之处，并把反事实结果提炼为细粒度的动作级监督，无需单独学习价值模型。我们构建了一个可扩展训练系统，将分布式世界模型搜索与异步真实机器人执行统一起来，形成自我强化的循环：真实世界经验持续改进世界模型，而更精准的世界模型又推动进一步的策略改进。我们将这一循环中世界模型一侧的过程称为测试时物理 grounding，这是手工构建的物理模拟器所不具备的能力：世界模型作为训练环境时，来自其所训练策略的真实转移会通过轻量级 LoRA 流程修正其动力学。在三项具有挑战性的真实世界任务上进行的实验表明，与最强基线相比，Rollback 在方块提取、抛球和桌面冰壶任务上的成功率分别绝对提高了 10.67%、11.11% 和 11.85%，且在整个训练过程中表现出更稳定的提升。尽管其初始化所用的遥操作演示远低于人类水平，Rollback 仍在 8 小时内训练至在抛球和桌面冰壶两项任务上超过人类玩家的平均成功率。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal intelligence can be viewed as human-guided co-evolution between worlds and agents through interaction. However, scaling this process faces two bottlenecks: constructing heterogeneous, verifiable environments is costly, and manual Harness iteration cannot keep pace with growing task diversity and complexity. A key insight is that tasks with different modalities and surface forms can share the same underlying capability requirements. We therefore introduce The Trinity, a recursive self-improvement framework coupling world generation with Harness evolution through three roles: Creator, Explorer, and Evolver. Drawing on verified execution trajectories, Evolver shifts the basis of task organization from surface categories to shared requirements, reorganizing the original task tree into a hierarchical capability tree. We introduce Capability-Driven Real2Sim2Real: for heterogeneous tasks at the same node, Creator abstracts their common requirements into simplified, verifiable simulated worlds for capability learning, while evaluation on original tasks measures transfer. Along this capability tree, Explorer progressively evolves reusable capability modules through selective inheritance, forming a Harness tree whose validated updates accumulate across iterations within a fixed topology. The resulting Harnesses specialize in different capabilities, motivating a Capability-Aware Harness Router that uses public task information to select compatible module configurations from the tree. Our evolved Harnesses improve mean performance by 34 points across 28 training benchmarks and 26 points across 18 unseen benchmarks, including two real-world embodied tasks.

    多模态智能可以被视为人类引导的世界与智能体通过交互共同演化的过程。然而，扩展这一过程面临两个瓶颈：构建异质且可验证的环境成本高昂，手动迭代 Harness 又无法跟上任务多样性和复杂性的增长。一个关键洞见是，模态和表面形式不同的任务可能具有相同的底层能力要求。因此，我们提出 The Trinity，这是一种通过 Creator、Explorer 和 Evolver 三种角色，将世界生成与 Harness 演化结合起来的递归自我改进框架。Evolver 借助经过验证的执行轨迹，将任务组织依据从表面类别转向共同需求，把原有任务树重组为分层能力树。我们提出能力驱动的 Real2Sim2Real：对于能力树同一节点上的异质任务，Creator 将它们的共同需求抽象为简化且可验证的模拟世界，以用于能力学习，同时通过在原始任务上的评估衡量迁移效果。沿着这棵能力树，Explorer 通过选择性继承逐步演化可复用的能力模块，形成一棵 Harness 树；经过验证的更新会在固定拓扑中跨迭代累积。由此产生的 Harness 针对不同能力进行专门化，这促使我们提出能力感知的 Harness Router，它利用公开任务信息从树中选择兼容的模块配置。经过演化的 Harness 在 28 个训练基准上将平均表现提高了 34 分，在 18 个未见基准上提高了 26 分，其中包括两项真实世界具身任务。

    Language model agents for clinical cohort curation should accommodate evolving eligibility criteria without repeatedly processing unchanged requirements. We introduce CohortFlow, a steerable agent that represents natural language corrections as localized updates to a structured cohort specification and reconciles them with a persistent execution graph. Explicitly recorded semantic dependencies enable affected computations to be selectively invalidated while preserving valid prior results. On 100 scenarios derived from clinical-trial eligibility criteria, comprising 126 correction turns, localized steering achieves 77.0% requirement micro-F1 versus 76.4% for full regeneration using the same 8B model, a small numerical advantage that is not statistically significant ($p=0.493$). It reduces mean correction latency by 64.8% after completion and 44.3% during execution, with 38.1% fewer model calls. In a separate proof-of-concept evaluation over MIMIC, all 13 cohort states execute successfully, while correction trajectories demonstrate selective preservation of unaffected computations and recomputation of changed or dependent nodes. Together, these results show that localized semantic steering can substantially reduce correction latency and model calls while maintaining strong requirement-level accuracy.

    上下文是一条流水线，而非一个窗口：LLM 智能体 Harness 中的信息损耗

    Yuvraj Sehgal, Mahsa Panahandeh, Naser Ezzati-Jivan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures how truncation in agent harnesses removes tool-output evidence and increases tool calls and computation, then models the context as a five-stage pipeline. This is a substantial empirical contribution about agent-system information flow, though its reasoning relevance is limited to evaluating diagnosis accuracy rather than explaining reasoning mechanisms.

    本文测量了智能体 Harness 中的截断如何移除工具输出证据、增加工具调用和计算量，并将上下文建模为五阶段流水线。这是关于智能体系统信息流的重要实证贡献；其与推理的关联仅限于评估诊断准确率，并未解释推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents are judged by two numbers: the size of the context window, and how often the final answer is correct. Both numbers miss a third thing: how much of a tool's output is lost before the model ever sees it. We measured this loss in a real tool-using agent. The agent finds the cause of injected faults by reading Linux kernel traces. The context window was almost empty: across 720 runs, the single largest prompt used only 5.75% of it. Yet a third of all tool results (3,827 of 11,189) were cut before they reached the model, and every cut result became broken JSON. The harness cut each result by slicing its JSON text at a fixed length. This does not shorten a result evenly. It deletes whatever data sits near the end. One field reached the model in only 4.7% of calls. A second field, in the very same results, reached the model in 99.3% of calls. Which field held the fault's evidence depended on when the faulty process started: early or late in the trace. The agent's diagnosis accuracy matched this same split. So we ran controlled experiments to test one question: did the data loss cause the drop in accuracy? This paper makes four contributions. First, we model an agent's context as a five-stage pipeline, with a measured failure at each stage. Second, we replay 864 real tool results, including one from a production trace where the shipped cut deletes all 128 records of the fault's evidence. Third, a controlled experiment shows that the cut's real cost appears first as extra work, not as wrong answers: 43% more tool calls, twice the computation, and yield falling from 0.61 to 0.31. The agent still finds the right answer when it has another way to reach it. Fourth, a survey of seven agent frameworks finds two that cut tool output the same unsafe way. Whether the data cut truly causes the accuracy drop is still an open question.

    中文

    人们通常用两个数字来评判 LLM 智能体：上下文窗口大小，以及最终答案的正确率。但这两个数字都忽略了第三件事：工具输出中有多少内容在模型看到之前就已丢失。我们在一个实际使用工具的智能体中测量了这种损失。该智能体通过读取 Linux 内核跟踪记录来查找注入故障的原因。上下文窗口几乎是空的：在 720 次运行中，最大的单个提示也只用了窗口容量的 5.75%。然而，所有工具结果中有三分之一（11,189 项中的 3,827 项）在到达模型之前就被截断，而且每个被截断的结果都变成了格式损坏的 JSON。Harness 通过在固定长度处切开 JSON 文本来截断每个结果。这并不会均匀缩短结果，而是删除靠近末尾的数据。某个字段仅在 4.7% 的调用中到达模型。同一结果中的另一个字段则在 99.3% 的调用中到达模型。故障证据位于哪个字段，取决于故障进程是在跟踪记录中较早还是较晚启动的。智能体的诊断准确率也呈现出同样的分化。因此，我们开展了对照实验，检验一个问题：数据丢失是否导致了准确率下降？本文有四项贡献。第一，我们将智能体上下文建模为一个五阶段流水线，并测量了每个阶段的故障。第二，我们重放了 864 项真实工具结果，其中包括一项来自生产跟踪记录的结果；该记录中，已部署的截断方式删除了故障证据的全部 128 条记录。第三，对照实验表明，截断的实际代价首先体现为额外工作，而不是错误答案：工具调用增加 43%，计算量翻倍，产出率从 0.61 降至 0.31。只要智能体还有其他途径获取正确答案，它仍然能够找到答案。第四，对七种智能体框架的调查发现，其中两种以同样不安全的方式截断工具输出。数据截断是否确实导致准确率下降，仍是一个开放问题。

    When Connectivity Misleads: Guiding Agentic Search with Contrastive Evidence Paths

    连接性何以误导：用对比证据路径引导智能体搜索

    Junchen Li, Liang Xu, Rongzheng Wang, Qizhi Chen, Junhao Wen, Shuang Liang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces path-based candidate scoring and a structured map for agents to verify sources and explore missing information, improving retrieval performance and cost. Its agent search organization is a substantial Systems contribution; evidence paths are incidental to composition and reasoning, with no claimed advances to those mechanisms.

    本文提出基于路径的候选项评分方法和结构化地图，使智能体能够核验来源并探索缺失信息，从而提升检索表现并降低成本。其智能体搜索组织方式是一项重要的系统贡献；证据路径与组合性和推理只是附带相关，并未声称在这些机制上有所推进。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Search agents can use cross-document graphs to discover sources through multi-hop connections and choose subsequent actions based on candidate rankings and relationships within a limited observation window. However, documents may rank highly because their numerous connections make them easier to reach, without necessarily providing more valuable evidence. Graph diffusion methods such as Personalized PageRank (PPR) aggregate propagation contributions from multiple sources, allowing highly connected distractor nodes to crowd the observation window. Flat node scores also obscure cross-document evidence trails, limiting continued exploration. We propose Contrastive Evidence Paths (CEP), which scores candidates by their strongest individual paths on a query-conditioned document graph and calibrates these scores against the same graph's background visitation distribution to mitigate structural bias. CEP ranks candidates by the calibrated scores and retains the corresponding source paths. Building on CEP, we develop Structured Corpus Interaction (SCI), which organizes candidates and their connecting paths into a structured Map, enabling agents to verify source documents and pursue missing information through expansion from anchor documents. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus and TREC-COVID show that SCI achieves state-of-the-art answer accuracy and nDCG@10 with the lowest generation cost. Compared with the strongest baselines by task performance, maximum reductions in tool calls and total generation costs exceed 50% and 40%, respectively. Further analysis confirms that SCI with CEP suppresses ranking inflation induced by structural connections and improves gold recall and exploration efficiency.

    中文

    搜索智能体可以利用跨文档图，通过多跳连接发现来源，并根据候选项排名及其在有限观察窗口内的关系来选择后续操作。然而，某些文档可能仅仅因为连接众多、更容易被访问而排名靠前，却未必能提供更有价值的证据。个性化 PageRank（PPR）等图扩散方法会汇总来自多个来源的传播贡献，因此连接密集的干扰节点可能挤占观察窗口。扁平的节点分数也会掩盖跨文档证据链，限制后续探索。我们提出对比证据路径（CEP），在经查询条件化的文档图上根据候选项最强的单条路径为其评分，并依据同一图的背景访问分布校准这些分数，以减轻结构偏差。CEP 根据校准后的分数对候选项排序，并保留对应的来源路径。在 CEP 的基础上，我们开发了结构化语料交互（SCI），将候选项及其连接路径组织成结构化 Map，使智能体能够核验来源文档，并通过从锚点文档扩展来追寻缺失信息。在 BrowseComp-Plus 和 TREC-COVID 上的实验表明，SCI 以最低的生成成本实现了最先进的答案准确率和 nDCG@10。按任务表现与最强基线相比，工具调用次数和总生成成本的最大降幅分别超过 50% 和 40%。进一步分析证实，采用 CEP 的 SCI 能抑制结构连接导致的排名虚高，并提高黄金答案召回率和探索效率。

    Mingkang Liu, Zhanghao Zhouyin, Guanghui Wang, Daye Zheng, Lei Shen, Qiangqiang Gu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    UniTB combines a physics-based Hamiltonian prior, expert routing, and efficient computation to build a model that generalizes across chemistry. The cross-chemistry result is relevant to generalization, but the abstract does not establish compositional learning or generalization mechanisms.

    UniTB 将基于物理的哈密顿量先验、专家路由和高效计算结合起来，构建了一个能够跨化学体系泛化的模型。跨化学体系的结果与泛化相关，但摘要并未确立组成学习或泛化机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Density functional theory (DFT) gives the electronic structure of materials, but its cost limits large-supercell calculations and materials screening. Machine-learned Hamiltonians bypass the self-consistent cycle but are usually system-specific; universal ones could cover new compositions and disordered solids. Such models must generalize across chemistry and keep downstream properties physical, while staying inexpensive for large cells. Here we introduce UniTB, a universal E(3) equivariant Hamiltonian representation framework that integrates physical priors rooted in density-functional tight-binding theory with deep learning. UniTB's network, which corrects a prior Hamiltonian, generalizes across chemistry through a mixture of experts routed by that prior and a charge-equilibration head as in self-consistent-charge tight binding. A projection bounds band shifts from the prior, suppressing spurious states and keeping downstream properties physical. We provide the fastest SO(2) tensor-product GPU kernels for the network. The variant UniTB-Flash assembles its prior from two-center tables at $O(N)$ cost for $N$ atoms, against $O(N\log N)$ on a grid. Trained on 29,242 crystals, UniTB reaches a 0.48 meV matrix-element error on nonmagnetic test crystals spanning 68 elements. Without amorphous training data, both models agree with DFT optics and conductivity of amorphous Ge-Sb-Te. UniTB-Flash ranks candidates with no significant difference from UniTB, whose property values are more accurate; together they screen 16,195 crystals for five application domains of industrial relevance.

    中文

    Maggie Chlon, Leon Chlon

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives and tests how finite capacity causes symmetry breaking, including its effects on attention-head representations and rotation sensitivity. This offers substantial insight into representation geometry and model mechanisms; its attention-head analysis also informs architecture, but systems design is not the central contribution.

    本文推导并检验了有限容量如何导致对称性破缺，包括其对注意力头表征和旋转敏感度的影响。这为表征几何和模型机制提供了重要见解；对注意力头的分析也有助于理解架构，但系统设计并非本文的核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    If rotating a problem never changes its answer, one might expect its best model to be rotation-invariant; we show that this fails, predictably and by an exact amount, when capacity is limited. A symmetry groups a model's directions into blocks of equally strong directions, a symmetric model must use each block whole, and when the budget cuts a block every optimal model breaks the symmetry. For a Gaussian problem with a $k$-unit bilinear predictor, the log-loss price of symmetry is exactly $(U_k-I_k)/(2\sigma^2)$, the signal of the best $k$ directions minus that of the best whole blocks. Because an attention head compares tokens through a similarity of rank at most its head dimension, whatever computation precedes it, the same price governs heads fitted to a symmetric similarity by squared error, and heads trained this way on three-dimensional directions break symmetry at exactly the predicted head dimensions, with the predicted rotation sensitivity (RMSE 0.004). Under softmax attention, flatter attention restores the predicted symmetric head where tested, while with peaked attention broken heads beat every whole-shell symmetric head at 16 of 20 head dimensions. We give a procedure that separates capacity-driven breaking from other causes.

    中文

    如果旋转一个问题永远不会改变答案，人们可能会认为它的最佳模型应当具有旋转不变性；我们表明，当容量有限时，这一预期会以可预测且精确的幅度失效。对称性会将模型的方向分组成强度相同的若干块，对称模型必须完整地使用每一块；当预算只能覆盖一块的一部分时，每个最优模型都会打破对称性。对于具有一个 $k$ 单位双线性预测器的高斯问题，对称性的对数损失代价恰好是 $(U_k-I_k)/(2\sigma^2)$，即最佳 $k$ 个方向的信号减去最佳完整方向块的信号。由于注意力头通过秩至多为其头维度的相似度来比较词元，无论此前进行了什么计算，对称相似度上通过平方误差拟合的注意力头都受同一代价支配；按此方式训练的注意力头在三维方向上恰好于预测的头维度打破对称性，并呈现预测的旋转敏感度（RMSE 为 0.004）。在 softmax 注意力下，在经过测试的情形中，较平缓的注意力会恢复预测的对称头；而在注意力尖锐时，破缺对称性的注意力头在 20 种头维度中的 16 种上胜过所有完整壳层的对称头。我们给出一种程序，用于区分由容量驱动的对称性破缺与其他原因造成的破缺。

    SpatialPC: Deep Computation with Sublinear Local Credit Propagation

    SpatialPC：具有次线性局部信用传播的深度计算

    Benjamin Prada, Shion Matsumoto, Ankur Arjun Mali

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SpatialPC studies how computation geometry determines local credit-propagation latency and gives a predictive-coding algorithm that achieves sublinear latency while preserving long computation depth. This substantially advances learning-system organization, while credit assignment alone does not establish model interpretability or reasoning capabilities.

    SpatialPC 研究计算几何如何决定局部信用传播的延迟，并提出一种预测编码算法，在保持较长计算深度的同时实现次线性延迟。这显著推进了学习系统的组织方式，但仅有信用分配并不能证明模型具备可解释性或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On a chain of $N$ states, any local learning rule with bounded communication range needs $\Theta(N)$ rounds before the loss can influence the earliest parameters, and this latency is usually attributed to depth. We show that it is a property of the communication geometry rather than of depth. For $N=m^d$ states placed at constant density in $d$ dimensions, a light-cone argument gives an $\Omega(N^{1/d})$ lower bound on the number of bounded-range rounds that any local algorithm needs before its gradient estimates can be sign-correct at every parameter. We construct a unit-range, degree-$2d$ directed acyclic graph that contains a Hamiltonian computation of length $N-1$ and in which every state lies within directed distance $d(m-1)=\Theta(N^{1/d})$ of the output, matching the lower bound. In the realizable-circuit model, depth and credit depth are therefore independent parameters: represented depth $\Theta(N)$ and causal credit latency $\Theta(N^{1/d})$ coexist, with a separation of order $N^{1-1/d}$. SpatialPC realizes this separation within predictive coding. Credit is propagated by adjoint prediction dynamics (APD), a local update whose $K$-round state on a settled acyclic graph is the truncated reverse-path sum $a^K=\sum_{k<K}(J^\top)^k b$, with error exactly $(J^\top)^K a^\star$. Graph geometry fixes when credit can first arrive at a state; the Jacobian-weighted path tail fixes how many further rounds accurate credit requires. A sparse two-dimensional Moore compiler retains the $N-1$ backbone with $\tfrac32N-2$ unit-range edges and has measured worst-node reachability $\sqrt N+2$ up to $N=65{,}536$, where a 65,535-edge backbone is reached in 258 local hops. With $T=2\sqrt N$ rounds, SpatialPC keeps finite-round task gradients aligned with settled gradients (cosine $0.93$ on MNIST and $0.97$ on Fashion-MNIST at $N=256$) and reaches $97.6\%$ and $88.1\%$ test accuracy after 20 epochs.

    中文

    在一条由 $N$ 个状态构成的链上，任何通信范围有界的局部学习规则，都需要经过 $\Theta(N)$ 轮，损失才能影响最早的参数；这种延迟通常归因于深度。我们表明，这是通信几何的性质，而非深度的性质。对于以恒定密度分布在 $N=m^d$ 维空间中的 $d$ 个状态，光锥论证给出了一个关于有界范围轮数的 $\Omega(N^{1/d})$ 下界：任何局部算法要使每个参数上的梯度估计符号都正确，都至少需要这么多轮。我们构造了一个单位范围、度数为 $2d$ 的有向无环图，其中包含长度为 $N-1$ 的哈密顿计算，并且每个状态到输出的有向距离都不超过 $d(m-1)=\Theta(N^{1/d})$，从而达到该下界。在可实现电路模型中，深度与信用深度因此是相互独立的参数：表征深度为 $\Theta(N)$，因果信用延迟为 $\Theta(N^{1/d})$，二者可以并存，且分离量级为 $N^{1-1/d}$。SpatialPC 在预测编码框架内实现了这种分离。信用通过伴随预测动力学（APD）传播；这是一种局部更新，在已稳定的无环图上运行 $K$ 轮后得到的状态是截断的反向路径和 $a^K=\sum_{k<K}(J^\top)^k b$，误差恰为 $(J^\top)^K a^\star$。图的几何结构决定信用何时最早能够到达某个状态；雅可比加权的路径尾部则决定准确信用还需要多少轮。稀疏二维 Moore 编译器以 $N-1$ 条单位范围边保留了 $\tfrac32N-2$ 主干结构，实测最差节点的可达性最高达到 $\sqrt N+2$，其中包含 65,535 条边的主干可在 258 次局部跳转内到达。在 $N=65{,}536$ 轮的情况下，SpatialPC 使有限轮数下的任务梯度与稳定后的梯度保持对齐（MNIST 上余弦相似度为 $T=2\sqrt N$，Fashion-MNIST 上为 $0.93$，在 $0.97$ 时），并在 20 个 epoch 后达到 $N=256$ 和 $97.6\%$ 的测试准确率。 $88.1\%$关键片段本身包含多个非公式占位符对应空值？

    Don't Pick a Winner: Knowledge Conflicts Need a Prior, Not a Rule

    别急着选赢家：知识冲突需要先验，而非规则

    Minh Pham Van, Cong Tran

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a decision-theoretic account and adaptive method for resolving conflicts between retrieved context and model knowledge, with evidence across context reliability mixtures. This substantially advances answer selection and calibration for reasoning, while the notes and selector are a limited system design rather than a main contribution to general agent architecture or internal mechanisms.

    本文提出关于如何解决检索上下文与模型知识冲突的决策论解释和自适应方法，并在不同上下文可靠性混合比例下提供证据。这显著推进了推理中的答案选择与校准；而笔记和选择器属于有限范围的系统设计，并非通用智能体架构或内部机制方面的主要贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A retrieval-augmented language model answers from two sources, the retrieved context and its own knowledge, and the two disagree whenever the context is incomplete or wrong. Existing methods settle the disagreement with a rule fixed at design time: follow the context, amplify it in proportion to how far it moves the model, or trust the model's memory. Each rule is confidently wrong in some deployment. In a decision-theoretic model of two sources, the score of any fixed rule is linear in the share of reliable contexts while the best attainable score is convex, so every fixed rule is beaten wherever it is not exactly optimal; and a symmetric divergence between the two sources, the signal adaptive decoding uses, carries no information about which one is right. Resolving a conflict therefore needs two inputs that no existing method keeps: evidence about each source separately, and a prior on how often the context is right. We test these claims on GRACE, a benchmark that intervenes on the knowledge-graph context of a fixed question, so that what the model knows, what the context says and what is true are measured separately. There, every baseline from four families is strong on right contexts or on wrong ones, never on both. We then build the two inputs: the model states its knowledge as notes, a small policy voices each note with a calibrated confidence, a reader answers in two voices, and a selector commits or abstains under a prior $\pi$ applied as an exact prior shift. With $\pi$ set to the true share of right contexts, the system is above the best baseline at every mixture of GRACE contexts, by up to 26 points. Its overall score is 45.3 and 35.0 (Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, Llama-3.1-8B), against 29.4 and 27.5 for the best baseline. On preregistered ClashEval it beats same-backbone CK-PLUG and TCR by 12 and 26 points. Where the model lacks the knowledge, the gains vanish, as the theory predicts.

    中文

    检索增强语言模型依据两个来源作答：检索到的上下文和模型自身的知识；只要上下文不完整或有误，两者就会出现分歧。现有方法用设计时固定的规则解决分歧：遵循上下文、按上下文对模型影响的程度放大其权重，或相信模型的记忆。每种规则在某些部署场景中都会自信地给出错误答案。在一个包含两个来源的决策论模型中，任何固定规则的得分都随可靠上下文所占比例线性变化，而可达到的最佳得分是凸函数；因此，除非某个固定规则恰好最优，否则在相应情形下总会有方法胜过它。两个来源之间的对称散度——自适应解码所使用的信号——无法提供哪一方正确的信息。因此，要解决冲突，需要两项现有方法都未同时保留的信息：关于每个来源各自的证据，以及上下文正确频率的先验。我们在 GRACE 上检验这些主张。该基准会干预固定问题的知识图谱上下文，因此可以分别测量模型知道什么、上下文说了什么以及事实是什么。在这个基准上，四类基线方法各自在上下文正确或错误时表现出色，却无法兼顾两者。随后我们构造出所需的两项信息：模型将自己的知识写成笔记；一个小型策略模型以经校准的置信度为每条笔记发声；一个阅读器以两种声音作答；选择器则依据先验 $\pi$ 决定作答或弃答，并将该先验作为精确的先验偏移来应用。当 $\pi$ 设为正确上下文的真实比例时，该系统在 GRACE 上所有上下文混合比例下都优于最佳基线，最高领先 26 个百分点。其总体得分为 45.3 和 35.0（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B、Llama-3.1-8B），而最佳基线为 29.4 和 27.5。在预注册的 ClashEval 上，它比使用相同骨干模型的 CK-PLUG 和 TCR 分别高出 12 和 26 个百分点。当模型不具备相关知识时，收益便会消失，这与理论预测一致。

    The paper contributes a GPU-parallel conflict-based planner that coordinates robot assignments, schedules, motions, and skills through reusable roadmaps and lazy conflict resolution.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-arm manipulation has the potential to dramatically improve the throughput, efficiency, and dexterity of many manipulation tasks. Recent work coordinates multiple robot arms in a shared workcell by allocating and scheduling tasks for greater parallelism, jointly planning multi-arm motions, or directly learning multi-arm policies. So far, these approaches are either too slow, rely on domain-specific assumptions, or scale poorly with the number of robots and task horizon. Thus, we introduce cuArms, a conflict-based planner co-designed with GPU parallelism that efficiently decomposes the search space using reusable multi-modal roadmaps for individual robots and resolves conflicts and deadlocks through a lazy search. To jointly optimize task assignment, schedules, motions, and manipulation skills, we integrate a high-level scheduler that proposes candidate skeletons for cuArms to ground into coordinated manipulation plans. Experimental results show that our method establishes a new state of the art, with real-time initial solutions and anytime improvements in both motion quality and scheduling, without days of domain-specific training required by learning approaches. Videos of both simulated and real-world industrial tasks are available on https://cuarms.github.io/.

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Models (LLM) are increasingly applied to Reverse Engineering (RE) workflows. RE, however, differs from common LLM coding tasks as it requires models to reason about low-level program behavior. Furthermore, the deployment of tooling in resource-constrained sandboxed RE environments limits the ability to use frontier-scale solutions. We examine whether a targeted LLM training approach can transfer distinct RE skills to open models via inverse basic-block execution: given an x86-64 basic block and a desired output register state, the model predicts the input register values that produce it. Fine-tuning \texttt{Qwen3-1.7B} and \texttt{Nemotron-3-Nano} with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises knowable-register prediction accuracy from 73.2\% to 85.3\% and from 63.3\% to 95.2\%, respectively. We release both fine-tuned models and the training dataset.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    OA-RAG combines ontology-based formal reasoning with LLM reasoning and evaluates grounding for medical question answering, a substantial contribution to reasoning systems.     OA-RAG 将基于本体的形式推理与 LLM 推理相结合，并针对医疗问答评估依据充分程度，是对推理系统的重要贡献。本体关系与组合能力有一定关联；而智能体和检索设置本身只能部分体现系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) perform well across many real-world tasks but remain prone to hallucination, limiting their reliability in domains such as biomedicine and healthcare, where answers must be grounded in established knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates this problem by incorporating external information, but often overlooks logical relationships and relies heavily on the LLM's own reasoning, which can compromise answer faithfulness. We propose OA-RAG, an agent that integrates formal reasoning with LLM reasoning, drawing on both the logical structure and informal annotations of domain ontologies. For each answer, OA-RAG reports the ontology observations used as evidence and a model-assessed grounding level (entailed, supported, related, or unrelated) that characterises the strength of that evidence. Across benchmarks derived from three large-scale ontologies and six real-world medical question-answering tasks, OA-RAG achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated ontology-fine-tuned and popular RAG methods, with particularly strong results on reasoning-intensive tasks. The reported grounding levels also offer a useful indication of answer reliability, with stronger grounding generally associated with higher accuracy. Finally, our results demonstrate the value of ontologies as knowledge sources: OA-RAG is competitive with, and sometimes outperforms, domain-specific RAG systems that draw on sources such as textbooks.

    Executable Archaeology of Programs That Model Programming: Reanimating the Heuristic Compiler (1961) and KBEmacs (1984)

    程序建模程序的可执行考古：重现启发式编译器（1961）与 KBEmacs（1984）

    Jeff Shrager, Kent M. Pitman, and Mia Golec

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper reanimates two historical theories of programming: one models programming as problem-solving, and the other builds programs by combining reusable cliches. This gives substantive insight into compositional programming and problem-solving, while AI-assisted reanimation is incidental to model mechanisms and system design.

    本文复现了两种历史编程理论：一种将编程建模为问题求解，另一种通过组合可复用的惯用模式来构建程序。这为组合式编程和问题求解提供了重要见解；AI 辅助复现只是项目中的辅助工具，与模型机制和系统设计无直接关系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Early AI programs were often also theories of how people think, and programs that wrote programs were, in part, theories of how people program. Here we report on the reanimation of two such programs that offer two seemingly different theories of programming and were developed for quite different purposes. The first, Herbert Simon's Heuristic Compiler (1961), was an experimental model of programming as problem-solving, applying the means-ends analysis methods of the General Problem Solver to investigate the nature of the programming task. The second, KBEmacs (1984), was a working prototype of an intelligent programming assistant developed by MIT's Programmer's Apprentice project, built on the view that expert programmers recognize and combine familiar patterns, or "cliches." It let a programmer build up programs by combining cliches through a stylized English command language. We approach both through the methodology of Executable Archaeology, the study of historical computational systems by running their original code, a process we call "reanimation." Our reanimation of the Heuristic Compiler reproduces the compiled code appearing in Simon's 1963 paper, and our reanimation of KBEmacs reproduces the SQRT sequence of its December 1984 self-test. Examined side by side, the two theories turn out to have much in common: the Heuristic Compiler also works by adapting existing routines, and Simon later argued that search alone requires a large body of programming knowledge. To highlight the reflexivity of this project, we deliberately used a modern AI-assisted programming tool, Anthropic's Claude Code (Opus 5.5), to carry out much of the detailed reanimation work, building on a significant base of existing software. The explicit, executable theories of programming that both systems embodied are largely absent from today's far more capable AI coding assistants.

    中文

    早期 AI 程序往往也是关于人类思维方式的理论，而编写程序的程序在某种程度上也是关于人类编程方式的理论。本文报告了对两个此类程序的复现，它们提出了看似不同的两种编程理论，且开发目的截然不同。第一个是 Herbert Simon 的启发式编译器（1961），它是一个将编程视为问题求解的实验模型，运用通用问题求解器的手段—目的分析方法来探究编程任务的本质。第二个是 KBEmacs（1984），由 MIT 的程序员学徒项目开发的智能编程助手工作原型；它基于这样一种观点：专家程序员能够识别并组合熟悉的模式，即“惯用模式”。它允许程序员通过风格化的英语命令语言组合惯用模式来逐步构建程序。我们以“可执行考古学”方法研究这两个程序，即通过运行历史计算系统的原始代码来研究它们；这一过程称为“复现”。我们对启发式编译器的复现重现了 Simon 1963 年论文中出现的编译代码；对 KBEmacs 的复现则重现了它在 1984 年 12 月自测中的 SQRT 序列。将两种理论并置考察后发现，它们有许多共同之处：启发式编译器同样通过调整现有例程来工作，而且 Simon 后来指出，仅搜索就需要大量编程知识。为了凸显本项目的反身性，我们特意使用现代 AI 辅助编程工具 Anthropic 的 Claude Code（Opus 5.5）完成了许多细致的复现工作，并以大量现有软件为基础。如今能力强得多的 AI 编程助手，在很大程度上缺少这两个系统所体现的、明确且可执行的编程理论。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    WAKMan adapts KV-cache eviction to live workload patterns, addressing memory management and serving efficiency for LLM systems. Its contribution is a practical adaptive policy, with no stated insight into model internals, composition, or reasoning.

    WAKMan 根据实时工作负载模式调整 KV 缓存淘汰，解决 LLM 系统中的内存管理和服务效率问题。它的贡献是一种实用的自适应策略，但没有声称揭示模型内部机制、组合性或推理方面的见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Prefix caching enables a Large Language Model (LLM) servers to reuse the Key-Value (KV) states and accelerate prefill computation stage for requests that share a prefix with earlier prompts, thus reducing latency and serving cost. With limited memory resource, the KV cache eviction policy becomes a decisive factor in determining the overall benefits of prefix caching. Production traffic may have single-turn, multi-turn, agentic, or a mixture of any combination of these request types. Our findings indicate that agentic steps return within seconds and favor recency, while popular prompts and long conversations return after many other requests and favor frequency. Across 20 mixes, no single policy is always best: vLLM's default strategy LRU provides 12% higher cache hits as compared to the frequency-oriented S3FIFO on agentic-heavy mixes but trails it by up to 22% elsewhere, and even a single workload parameter can flip the winner even for any particular mix. We present WAKMan, a workload-aware KV cache manager that picks its eviction policy from live traffic without knowing request types or reading prompts. It improves hit rate over LRU by 5 percentage points on average, with the lowest mean and worst-case optimality gap of all policies.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FRA allocates adapter ranks across layers and a shared fleet budget using functional distortion measurements, dynamic programming, and end-to-end verification. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to efficient model serving, while its use of adapter compression does not investigate internal representations, composition, or reasoning.

    FRA 使用功能失真测量、动态规划和端到端验证，在各层之间以及共享的集群预算内分配适配器秩。这是对高效模型服务的一项重要算法贡献；尽管使用了适配器压缩，但并未研究内部表征、组合性或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a key mechanism for efficiently specializing foundation models into many task- and user-specific variants. Serving many LoRA adapters under a shared resource budget turns post-hoc compression into a two-level allocation problem: rank must be distributed across layers within each adapter and across adapters within the fleet. Although trained LoRAs contain substantial spectral redundancy, spectral reconstruction alone does not determine how much compression an adapter can functionally tolerate. We formulate fleet compression through a functional rank-distortion frontier for each adapter, followed by fleet-level minimax allocation under a shared rank budget. Given exact frontiers, this decomposition is equivalent to joint optimization over all layer ranks. We introduce Functional Rank Allocation (FRA), an unlabeled method for constructing practical frontiers. FRA measures isolated module truncations end to end, uses these measurements as an additive search surrogate solved by dynamic programming, remeasures every complete candidate, and takes the lower-risk envelope with a complementary spectral proposal before exact minimax allocation over the constructed frontiers. Across 78 adapters from three public fleets, FRA improves worst-case and tail utility over uniform spectral compression in constrained-budget regimes. Fixed-budget probes show that isolated costs rank candidates well, but their calibration shifts across proposal shapes; end-to-end verification and the spectral proposal therefore limit functional-search error.

    中文

    低秩适配（LoRA）已成为一种关键机制，可将基础模型高效地专门化为许多面向任务和用户的变体。在共享资源预算下服务多个 LoRA 适配器，使事后压缩成为一个两级分配问题：既要在每个适配器内部的各层之间分配秩，也要在整个适配器集群中的适配器之间分配秩。尽管训练后的 LoRA 含有大量谱冗余，仅靠谱重建无法确定适配器在功能上能够承受多大程度的压缩。我们通过为每个适配器构建功能秩失真前沿，并在共享秩预算下进行集群级极小极大分配，来形式化集群压缩问题。给定精确的前沿，这种分解等价于对所有层的秩进行联合优化。我们提出功能秩分配（FRA），这是一种无需标签、用于构建实用前沿的方法。FRA 端到端测量单个模块的截断效果，将这些测量作为加性搜索代理目标，并用动态规划求解；随后重新测量每个完整候选方案，并与互补的谱提案取较低风险包络，再基于所构建的前沿进行精确的极小极大分配。在来自三个公开集群的 78 个适配器上，在预算受限的情况下，FRA 相较于统一谱压缩提升了最坏情况效用和尾部效用。固定预算探测表明，单独测得的成本能够较好地为候选方案排序，但其校准会随提案形状而变化；因此，端到端验证和谱提案限制了功能搜索误差。

    MAREval proposes a planner, moderator, and arbitrator framework with debate prompting and sampling to make LLM evaluations of recommendation explanations more stable and human-aligned.     ENGLISH

    Evaluating natural language explanations in recommender systems is essential for fostering user trust, transparency, and engagement. However, existing evaluation approaches like human evaluations, while accurate, are resource-intensive and impractical at the scale required by modern recommendation platforms. Also, automated methods using single-agent LLMs suffer from prompt sensitivity and inconsistent outputs. To address these challenges, we propose MAREval, a structured multi-agent framework for evaluating recommendation explanations using large language models. MAREval orchestrates (i) a planner agent that uses a novel Chain of Debate (CoD) prompting strategy to coordinate agent roles and enforce logically consistent evaluation plans; (ii) a moderator agent that regulates discussions by mitigating prompt drift; and (iii) an arbitrator agent that aggregates outputs from multiple evaluation rounds and (iv) a Monte Carlo sampling method, improving robustness and alignment with human judgment. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on both public (TopicalChat) and proprietary recommendation datasets, demonstrating that MAREval outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Comprehensive experiments on a public benchmark and a proprietary e-commerce dataset show that MAREval improves alignment with human judgments over strong singleand multi-agent baselines. Stability analyses indicate substantially lower variability across repeated trials. In a large human-annotation gate, MAREval meets production quality thresholds where prior evaluators fall short, and online A/B testing demonstrates statistically significant improvements in engagement and revenue metrics. These results establish MAREval as a scalable and reliable solution for human-aligned evaluation of recommendation explanations in real-world systems

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Each new generation of frontier model pushes the edge of what is possible. Inside a harness -- a loop, a shell, a filesystem, the ability to write and run its own code -- a model can take on increasingly difficult work. A growing body of work treats the coding-agent harness as infrastructure for knowledge work rather than a coding tool, and a new wave of benchmarks tests it there. Most of them are generative: build a financial model, a memo, a spreadsheet from a brief, judged by a rubric or by another model. Few test the expensive part of knowledge work, which is investigative. In audit, tax, due diligence, regulatory reporting, claims or any dispute over numbers, the answer already exists -- hidden in incomplete and inconsistent evidence spread across systems -- and has to be recovered and defended to the cent. We introduce kw-bench, a benchmark built from real engagements specialists described to us. Its first task family is a five-year VAT reconstruction across three generations of SAP -- legacy ECC, a partial S/4HANA migration and a consultant's redesign -- delivered as raw system extracts: page headers, local number formats, partial link tables, no documentation of how anything connects. Grading is deterministic, with no LLM judge. We ran four harnesses -- Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and micro-cc -- on the same model, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash, for two hours. The two independent, model-agnostic harnesses delivered (OpenCode 0.542, micro-cc 0.528); the two lab harnesses, away from their home model, delivered nothing (0.00 each). What defeated them was inertia: keeping many weak signals alive across a long session. On a frontier model the task collapses. micro-cc and Claude Code on Claude Opus 5.5 scored 0.9986 and 1.000, in 22 and 25 minutes. A weeks-long engagement now costs minutes and a few dollars; below the frontier, the harness decides how far a model gets.

    Tool-assisted planning success can reflect external search and verification, leaving a model's unaided planning ability unresolved. We isolate innate planning through complete plans generated in one response without tools or execution feedback. We propose a verifiable framework that decomposes success-weighted plan efficiency as $\mathrm{SPE}=R\times Q\times E$: execution reliability, planning coordination among legal plans, and action economy among completed plans. Trajectory replay and certified optima verify these factors; the joint score includes unsuccessful attempts. We evaluate 8,400 full-plan outputs from seven model conditions on $4\times4$ sliding puzzles, controlling exact horizon and obstacle count in the primary cohort. Models that complete every trial still become less economical at longer horizons, while higher efficiency among completed plans can coexist with poor goal attainment. SPE separates the overall capability hierarchy, while its factors distinguish coordination failure from inefficient completion. The framework makes long-horizon limitations in unaided planning quantitatively verifiable.

    Web-based applications increasingly rely on understanding long multimodal documents, where answering questions often requires combining information across pages, tables, and figures. However, Agentic execution is not always necessary, introducing additional computation and potentially incorrect answers. Our empirical analysis reveals that Agentic execution provides query-dependent benefits, while additional operations may improve, preserve, or degrade answer accuracy. Adaptive Path Routing preserves exact answering and predicts the relative benefit of Agent over shorter execution paths. Dynamic Agent Execution maintains an evolving workspace and refines Planner proposals to control tool use and termination.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper evaluates how LLM agents distinguish correction from manipulation and whether that judgment carries over to policy-governed actions, finding that concession rates alone are misleading.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents that answer questions and act on behalf of users must decide when to yield to a user who disagrees. Disagreement may correct a genuine error or may be an attempt at manipulation. Prior work shows that models frequently abandon correct answers when challenged by users, yet it remains unclear whether they distinguish correction from manipulation or merely differ in their propensity to concede. We examine this question across seven LLMs from four vendors in two studies, one on the answers agents give and one on the actions they take as customer-support agents whose policy permits account changes only for verified users. Simulated users push toward correct and incorrect answers with graded pressure. Following research on epistemic vigilance, the pressure either appeals to the source, such as claimed authority, or offers content the agent cannot verify, namely a cited source. Drawing on signal detection theory, we measure on a set of benchmark questions how much more readily each agent concedes to correction than to manipulation, separately from its overall propensity to concede. Citations made five of seven models readier to concede and four worse at discriminating, while stronger wording added little. In the agentic study, five models never violated the verification policy, including models that readily abandoned correct answers, so concession on answers did not predict violations of policy. Ministral 3B violated the policy mainly under claimed authority, and Ministral 8B reported changes it had not made. An instruction to revise only on verifiable evidence chiefly shifted propensity to concede rather than improving discrimination. Concession rates alone are therefore misleading, and agents should be evaluated on both their discrimination and the actions they take.

    中文

    代表用户回答问题并采取行动的 LLM 智能体必须判断何时应听从提出异议的用户。异议可能是在纠正真正的错误，也可能是在试图操纵智能体。先前研究表明，用户提出质疑时，模型经常放弃正确答案；但尚不清楚它们是否能够区分纠正与操纵，还是仅仅在让步倾向上有所不同。我们在两项研究中考察了来自四家供应商的七种 LLM：一项研究智能体给出的答案，另一项研究智能体作为客服人员采取的行动；相关政策规定，只有经过验证的用户才能更改账户。模拟用户施加不同程度的压力，引导智能体给出正确或错误的答案。根据认知警觉性研究，压力要么诉诸来源，例如声称自己具有权威，要么提供智能体无法验证的内容，即引用某个来源。借助信号检测理论，我们针对一组基准问题衡量每个智能体在多大程度上更容易接受纠正而非操纵，并将其与整体让步倾向分开考察。引用来源使七个模型中的五个更容易让步，并使四个模型的辨别能力变差；更强硬的措辞则几乎没有额外影响。在智能体研究中，五个模型从未违反验证政策，其中包括那些容易放弃正确答案的模型，因此，对答案的让步并不能预测是否违反政策。Ministral 3B 主要在遇到声称的权威时违反政策，而 Ministral 8B 则报告了实际上并未执行的更改。要求模型仅依据可验证证据进行修正的指令，主要改变了让步倾向，而非提升辨别能力。因此，单看让步率会产生误导；评估智能体时，应同时考察其辨别能力和采取的行动。

    CoHARL：通过强化学习协同进化智能体策略与可执行工具框架

    Jianwen Chen, Peng Xia, Kaide Zeng, Siwei Han, Zhen-Yu Zhang, Charles Fleming, Xinyu Ye, Huaxiu Yao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CoHARL jointly trains an LLM agent policy and adapts its executable tool-use harness through reinforcement learning, improving task resolution. This is a substantial contribution to agent organization and training, while the abstract reports task gains rather than insights into reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    CoHARL 通过强化学习联合训练 LLM 智能体策略，并调整其可执行工具使用框架，从而提高任务解决率。这是对智能体组织方式和训练的一项重要贡献；摘要报告的是任务表现提升，并未揭示推理机制或组合泛化方面的见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents interact with their environments through executable harnesses that govern tool use and feedback. Optimizing a harness for a fixed policy overlooks how its behavior changes during learning, while training a policy under a fixed harness leaves the interface that generates its training experience unchanged. This motivates adapting the harness throughout policy training. We introduce CoHARL, a population-based reinforcement learning framework that co-evolves a shared policy and a population of executable harnesses. The policy learns from rollouts across the population, and a proposer uses its execution traces to revise harness code during training. CoHARL achieves a 27.6% mean resolved rate on SWE-rebench, improving over harness-only search by 6.4 percentage points. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show gains in software engineering and terminal-based tasks. Under matched training budgets, CoHARL also outperforms searching for a harness once before RL and alternating policy updates with revisions to a single active harness.

    When to Intervene? An Empirical Study of Errors and Self-Recovery in LLM Agents

    何时介入？LLM 智能体错误与自我恢复的实证研究

    Chiming Duan, Tong Jia, Yingxi Chen, Minghua He, Lingzhe Zhang, Ying Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies when LLM agents recover from execution errors and proposes a predictor to guide intervention, offering a substantial empirical and algorithmic contribution to agent execution. Self-recovery is not analyzed as a reasoning mechanism, so its connection to Reasoning is incidental.

    本文研究 LLM 智能体何时能从执行错误中恢复，并提出一种用于指导介入的预测器，为智能体执行领域提供了重要的实证和算法贡献。文中并未将自我恢复作为推理机制进行分析，因此它与推理只有附带关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents interact with Web services to perform tasks on users' behalf. Errors during these interactions can disrupt execution and prevent task completion, motivating external intervention. However, agents may self-recover through continued execution, raising the question of when to intervene and when to wait for self-recovery. We present an empirical study of errors and self-recovery in LLM agents. We construct ReInBench, a dataset containing 1,259 agent traces and 1,403 error events across computer-use and Web tasks. Our study examines how often and how quickly agents self-recover, how self-recovery relates to subsequent execution and task completion, and whether self-recovery can be predicted when an error occurs. We find that 725 error events self-recover, often within a few steps, with self-recovery performance differing across Execution LLMs. Self-recovery can also help agents recover from subsequent errors of the same type and support overall task completion. Intervention should therefore prioritize errors unlikely to self-recover, while allowing agents to continue when self-recovery is likely. Building on these empirical findings, we propose ReCoF, a method that predicts whether an error will self-recover to inform whether additional intervention is needed. ReCoF achieves an average relative improvement of 9.02% in Macro-F1 over the strongest baseline on ReInBench. Our code and data can be found at https://method-notes.github.io/ReCoF/.

    中文

    LLM 智能体会与 Web 服务交互，代表用户执行任务。这些交互中的错误可能中断执行并阻碍任务完成，因此需要外部介入。然而，智能体可能通过继续执行来自我恢复，这就引出了何时应该介入、何时应该等待自我恢复的问题。我们对 LLM 智能体的错误和自我恢复进行了实证研究。我们构建了 ReInBench 数据集，其中包含计算机使用和 Web 任务中的 1,259 条智能体轨迹和 1,403 个错误事件。我们的研究考察了智能体自我恢复的频率和速度、自我恢复与后续执行及任务完成之间的关系，以及发生错误时能否预测自我恢复。我们发现，有 725 个错误事件实现了自我恢复，通常在几步之内完成；不同执行 LLM 的自我恢复表现各异。自我恢复还可以帮助智能体从后续发生的同类型错误中恢复，并有助于完成整体任务。因此，应优先介入那些不太可能自行恢复的错误，而在可能自我恢复时允许智能体继续执行。基于这些实证发现，我们提出 ReCoF，这种方法可预测错误是否能够自我恢复，以判断是否需要进一步介入。在 ReInBench 上，ReCoF 的 Macro-F1 平均相对提升 9.02%，超过最强基线。我们的代码和数据见 https://method-notes.github.io/ReCoF/。

    Utkarsh Kanwat

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper folds attention-logit biases into keys so compacted KV caches can run on standard serving kernels, with an error bound and empirical comparisons. This is a substantial contribution to model computation and serving; long-context task performance is incidental evidence, not a contribution to reasoning mechanisms.

    本文将注意力 logit 偏置折入键向量，使压缩后的 KV 缓存能够在标准服务内核上运行，并提供误差界和实证比较。这是对模型计算和服务的实质性贡献；长上下文任务表现只是附带证据，并非对推理机制的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Attention Matching (AM) compacts a KV cache by keeping some keys per head, refitting their values and adding a bias to each kept key's logit. FlashAttention and vLLM's paged caches have no input for it. We fold the bias into the keys along one closed-form direction per head, fitted on context queries, giving a plain cache with AM's size and head dimension and the model's own query path; the output error is bounded by how far each query's projection on that direction is from 1. With equal per-head budgets, unmodified vLLM serves folded caches through a KV connector, matching Hugging Face's answers on all 51 Qwen3-4B questions and its greedy output on 180 of 200 Qwen3-14B LongBench samples. With equal budgets on QuALITY (Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, 8B, Llama-3.1-8B) and LongHealth (three Qwen3 models), the fold is within noise of AM's accuracy in 13 of 14 settings, with lower KL to the full cache than dropping the bias in all 12 where both ran. Under the published per-head budgets, on Qwen3-4B, its Instruct-2507 variant and Llama-3.1-8B, it is within noise of AM in 9 of 10, no longer beats dropping the bias in KL, and the two each win once in accuracy.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As agents collaborate on longer tasks, responsibility may pass between models before the work is complete. The receiving model must build on prior decisions, observations, and actions while addressing the remaining requirements. Evaluating this transition requires connecting the information preserved at handoff to how the receiver continues the work, a relationship that task-success and memory-retention scores alone do not capture. We introduce the Handoff State Continuity Benchmark (HSC-Bench), comprising 1,039 tasks that evaluate two complementary aspects of task takeover: recovering relevant repository evidence and continuing from established conversational, tool, and file-work state. Comparisons across six receiving models show that structured handoff state improves repository evidence recovery for every model and continuation performance for most models. The strongest receivers differ between the two tracks, showing that evidence-recovery rankings alone do not characterize performance when continuing from inherited state. By combining these comparisons with checks of subsequent responses and actions, HSC-Bench evaluates both access to prior evidence and adherence to established commitments and completed work. This provides a basis for selecting receiving models and assessing handoff representations according to the work that must be carried forward.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recently, LLM-based autonomous agents have shown strong capabilities in iteratively generating, evaluating, and refining executable solutions. In robotic manipulation, Code-as-Policy lets these agents search over modular and editable robot programs. However, effective program search requires physical understanding: agents must understand how objects can be manipulated, how scene geometry constrains actions, and why interactions succeed or fail. Existing methods rely mainly on execution feedback for program refinement, often leaving these physical questions unresolved. We introduce RoboAuto, a framework for robot program search that explicitly organizes physical understanding at the object, scene, and interaction levels through three components. First, a hierarchical knowledge base combines executable skills with object-centric knowledge of affordances, spatial relations, and action effects, learned from embodied data and online task solving. Second, scene grounding connects this knowledge to the current environment by identifying relevant objects and resolving action-critical quantities. Third, multi-stage planning with self-designed experiments checks whether each stage produces its expected physical effects and actively tests competing hypotheses to resolve physical uncertainties. RoboAuto achieves superior performance across five benchmark families, attaining an 89.1% success rate on short-horizon LIBERO-PRO tasks and more than twice the mean success rate of ASPIRE on LIBERO-PRO Long and LIBERO-Plus. It also outperforms ASPIRE and $\pi_{0.5}$ on three challenging long-horizon real-robot tasks requiring precise manipulation. We further show that the knowledge base transfers across simulators and embodiments, and that program search performance scales with its size. Project page: https://roboauto-ai.github.io/

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

This offers substantial insight into agent monitoring and task execution (Systems), and a limited contribution to decision-making (Reasoning); its use of Blackwell's framework alone does not study model internals or compositional generalization.

    本文提出决策价值准则和有限样本审计方法，用于判断智能体应该重启还是继续工作，并提供基于轨迹的重启结果证据。这为智能体监控和任务执行提供了实质性见解（Systems），对决策有有限贡献（Reasoning）；仅仅使用 Blackwell 框架并不意味着研究了模型内部机制或组合泛化。

    ENGLISH

    Classification accuracy and true-positive and false-positive rates alone do not determine whether restarting an AI agent improves success. Using an exact alarm-to-action identity for an independent clean restart with zero monitoring overhead, we show analytically that a monitor with fixed 90% accuracy can swing from a five-percentage-point loss to a 35-point gain in success rate, depending solely on the replacement attempt's residual-budget success probability. We introduce two techniques for evaluating monitors and progress signals in decision terms. First, a decision-sufficiency criterion, a binary-action specialization of Blackwell's comparison of experiments, identifies which progress representations or context compressions preserve the information needed to choose optimally between the specified actions, independent of trace reconstruction fidelity. Second, a finite-sample, model-free decision audit uses simultaneous binomial intervals over existing agent traces, without additional model calls, to certify a preference for "restart" or "continue" under stated sampling assumptions, or return "abstain" when evidence is insufficient. In a study of 194 externally evaluated model executions on 19 selected SymPy issues from SWE-bench Verified, with a retrospective audit of 130 of these traces, we find a 2.29-point apparent restart gain traced to a single surviving failed attempt, a 42.29-point loss on a second model, no positive replication of the initial gain on prospective task cohorts, and zero of 103 live comparisons meeting the specified certification bar. These results motivate evaluating agent monitors through recovery opportunity, decision value, and statistical support, rather than classification performance alone.

    仅凭分类准确率、真正率和假正率，无法确定重启 AI 智能体是否能提高成功率。我们针对无监控开销的独立干净重启，利用一个精确的“告警到行动”恒等式进行分析，证明准确率固定为 90% 的监控器，带来的成功率变化可能从降低 5 个百分点到提高 35 个百分点不等，唯一取决于替代尝试在剩余预算下成功的概率。我们提出两种从决策角度评估监控器和进展信号的技术。第一，决策充分性准则是 Blackwell 实验比较在二元行动情形下的特化形式，它能识别哪些进展表示或上下文压缩保留了在指定行动之间作出最优选择所需的信息，而不受轨迹重建保真度影响。第二，一种有限样本、无模型的决策审计使用现有智能体轨迹上的同时二项区间，无需额外调用模型；在既定抽样假设下，它可以确认应当“重启”还是“继续”，若证据不足则返回“弃权”。在一项研究中，我们从 SWE-bench Verified 中选取了 19 个 SymPy 问题，对 194 次模型执行进行外部评估，并对其中 130 条轨迹进行回顾性审计。研究发现，表面上重启带来的 2.29 个百分点收益可追溯到一次未被消除的失败尝试；另一个模型则损失了 42.29 个百分点；初步收益未能在前瞻性任务队列中得到正向复现；在 103 次实时比较中，没有一次达到指定的认证门槛。这些结果表明，评估智能体监控器时，应考察恢复机会、决策价值和统计支持，而非只看分类表现。

    Shuo Chen, Li Cui, Cunxin Huang, Ya-Feng Liu, Minghang Xie, Meng Xu, and Zaikun Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    NextEval combines an LLM agent, numerical tools, shared evaluation history, and budget allocation to select evaluations for derivative-free optimization. Its agent and tool orchestration is a substantial model-system contribution, while reasoning is incidental to the optimization task and the abstract gives no insight into internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    NextEval 将 LLM 智能体、数值工具、共享评估历史和预算分配结合起来，为无导数优化选择评估点。其智能体与工具编排是对模型系统的实质性贡献；推理只是优化任务中附带的一环，摘要也没有揭示模型内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Derivative-free optimization (DFO) addresses problems where derivatives are unavailable or costly to obtain. This setting often arises in simulation-based and experimental applications, where evaluating the black-box objective can itself be costly. Thus, it remains a central challenge in DFO to effectively exploit accumulated observations to select informative evaluation points under a limited budget. In this light, we introduce the NextEval solver, an agent-based DFO solver, which integrates the capabilities of a large language model (LLM) to guide the sequential selection of evaluation points. Specifically, we establish a system that combines an LLM agent with a numerical environment. The environment provides tools for analyzing past evaluations and executing numerical methods, while maintaining a shared evaluation history and method-specific state to support continuation across method switches. Using observations and tool feedback, the LLM agent selects tools, configures their parameters, and allocates the evaluation budget, while numerical methods compute and evaluate candidate points. Building on this system, we also introduce NextEval Bench, a benchmark protocol for comparing agent configurations on shared DFO tasks using the same numerical tools under matched evaluation budgets and information constraints. Numerical results on low-dimensional DFO problems demonstrate that the NextEval solver outperforms the state-of-the-art DFO baselines in function-evaluation efficiency.

    中文

    无导数优化（DFO）针对无法获得导数或获取导数代价高昂的问题。这类情形常见于基于模拟和实验的应用中，因为评估黑箱目标函数本身可能成本很高。因此，在有限预算下有效利用累积的观测结果来选择有信息量的评估点，仍是 DFO 的核心挑战。为此，我们推出 NextEval 求解器，这是一种基于智能体的 DFO 求解器，它结合大型语言模型（LLM）的能力，引导评估点的顺序选择。具体而言，我们搭建了一个结合 LLM 智能体和数值环境的系统。该环境提供用于分析过往评估和执行数值方法的工具，同时维护共享的评估历史和特定于方法的状态，以支持在不同方法间切换后继续运行。LLM 智能体利用观测结果和工具反馈选择工具、配置其参数并分配评估预算，而数值方法则计算并评估候选点。在此系统基础上，我们还推出 NextEval Bench，这是一种基准评测方案，用于在相同的数值工具、匹配的评估预算和信息约束下，对同一组 DFO 任务上的智能体配置进行比较。低维 DFO 问题上的数值结果表明，NextEval 求解器在函数评估效率方面优于最先进的 DFO 基线方法。

    Yanyan Zhang, Fei Shen, Ting Yan, Hao Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CASEL proposes a consequence-aware policy for allocating verification, sandboxing, approval, and other interventions to tool calls, and evaluates allocation rules in simulation with explicit assumptions. This is a substantial agent-systems contribution, with limited relevance to reasoning because it allocates safeguards rather than developing reasoning capabilities; it does not study model mechanisms or composition.

    CASEL 提出一种后果感知策略，用于将验证、沙箱运行、审批及其他干预分配给工具调用，并在明确假设下通过模拟评估分配规则。这是对智能体系统的实质性贡献；它分配的是防护措施而非开发推理能力，因此与推理的关联有限；本文也未研究模型机制或组合性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tool-using language agents increasingly modify external systems, yet most runtime safeguards allocate scrutiny by generic uncertainty scores or coarse mutation heuristics. We introduce CASEL (Consequence-Aware Selective Execution Layer), a model-agnostic runtime allocation policy that combines calibrated failure probability, state-dependent consequence, reversibility, ambiguity, and evidence freshness to choose, for each proposed tool call, among direct execution, verification, sandboxing, clarification, approval, and abstention by minimizing a per-mode cost. We formalize direct execution as selective prediction and state and test the validity conditions of a finite-sample threshold and a trajectory risk ledger. In a controlled simulation over 20 seeds with 120,000 test actions each, in which every method has the same intervention menu and the same compute cost, CASEL reduces harmful-side-effect trajectories from 14.75 percent for an uncertainty-ranked gate to 7.02 percent and mean normalized harm from 0.184 to 0.123. A gate ranked by the product of failure probability and consequence reaches similar harm (5.82 percent, 0.120) but sends 45 percent more actions to human approval, and removing reversibility-aware routing raises the rate to 15.53 percent. A trajectory-level risk budget, in contrast, increases harm at equal cost (11.82 percent). Intervention effectiveness is assumed, not measured: the results rank allocation rules under the simulator's assumptions and do not establish deployment effectiveness.

    中文

    工具使用型语言智能体日益频繁地修改外部系统，但大多数运行时防护机制仍根据通用不确定性分数或粗略的变更启发式来分配审查力度。我们推出 CASEL（后果感知型选择性执行层），这是一种与模型无关的运行时分配策略。它综合校准后的失败概率、依赖状态的后果、可逆性、歧义性和证据时效性，为每个拟议的工具调用选择直接执行、验证、沙箱运行、澄清、审批或弃权，并使各模式的成本最小化。我们将直接执行形式化为选择性预测，并陈述和检验有限样本阈值与轨迹风险账本的有效条件。在一项包含 20 个随机种子、每个种子 120,000 个测试操作的受控模拟中，所有方法采用相同的干预选项和计算成本。CASEL 将有害副作用轨迹的比例从按不确定性排序的门控方法所达到的 14.75% 降至 7.02%，并将平均归一化危害从 0.184 降至 0.123。按失败概率与后果乘积排序的门控方法达到相近的危害水平（5.82%，0.120），但送交人工审批的操作多出 45%；移除基于可逆性的路由后，该比例升至 15.53%。相比之下，在成本相同的条件下，轨迹级风险预算会增加危害（11.82%）。干预效果是本文的假设，并未经过测量：这些结果只是在模拟器假设下对分配规则进行排序，无法证明其在部署中的效果。

    Chuming Wei, Churui Yang, Zihan Zhang, Ruien Li, Wusheng Zhang, Yan Zhang, Guangwen Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ADTGuard develops token-level streaming safety detection, including a prefix-conditioned layer router and a method for refining token-level targets from response labels. This offers a substantial algorithmic contribution to adaptive model computation, while its use of internal layers is for safety prediction rather than interpretability, and safety detection is not itself a reasoning contribution.

    ADTGuard 开发了 token 级流式安全检测方法，其中包括一个由前缀条件化的层路由器，以及一种根据回答级标签细化 token 级目标的方法。这对自适应模型计算作出了实质性的算法贡献；其内部层用于安全预测，而非可解释性；安全检测本身也不属于推理能力贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate fluent responses to diverse user requests, yet streaming may expose users to harmful content before generation is complete. Existing guardrails face two limitations in this setting. First, post-hoc moderation at response or chunk boundaries delays intervention, risking harmful exposure when content is released before verification. Second, even with token-level detection, coarse response-level supervision does not specify when harmful content begins, while fixed-layer readouts may miss relevant safety signals at other depths. To address these limitations, we introduce ADTGuard, which checks each token before release, progressively refines token-level training targets, and adapts layer selection to the current prefix. ADTGuard models risk across depth and time through Depth-Time Safety Dynamics (DTSD), which integrates safety evidence across layers at each token and uses it to guide risk accumulation over successive tokens. To adapt the choice of observation layers to the current prefix, we propose the Causal Depth Router (CDR). With only response-level labels available, we further develop Risk-Onset Target Refinement (RTR) to progressively construct token-level training targets for both components. Through extensive experiments across multiple safety benchmarks, we demonstrate that ADTGuard consistently achieves strong streaming detection performance, matching or surpassing state-of-the-art safeguards while requiring only 16M trainable parameters and maintaining competitive per-token latency.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）能够针对多种用户请求生成流畅回答，但流式输出可能在生成完成前就让用户看到有害内容。现有防护机制在这种场景下有两个局限。第一，在回答或文本块边界进行事后审核会延迟干预；如果内容未经验证就已发布，用户便可能接触到有害内容。第二，即使采用 token 级检测，粗粒度的回答级监督也无法指出有害内容从何时开始，而固定层的读出可能会漏掉其他深度上的相关安全信号。为解决这些局限，我们推出 ADTGuard：它在每个 token 发布前进行检查，逐步细化 token 级训练目标，并根据当前前缀调整层选择。ADTGuard 通过深度—时间安全动态（DTSD）对深度和时间维度上的风险建模：它在每个 token 处整合各层的安全证据，并以此引导风险随后续 token 累积。为使观测层的选择适应当前前缀，我们提出因果深度路由器（CDR）。在只有回答级标签可用的情况下，我们进一步开发了风险起点目标细化（RTR），为这两个组件逐步构造 token 级训练目标。通过在多个安全基准上进行大量实验，我们证明 ADTGuard 始终能取得出色的流式检测表现，达到或超过最先进的防护方法，同时仅需 16M 个可训练参数，并保持有竞争力的每 token 延迟。

    回忆还是重学？面向反复出现的概念漂移的上下文内专家混合

    Zhangkai Wu, Xu Zhang, Zhihong Cui, Yiqi Wang, Yi Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MICE addresses recurring concept drift by mixing stored contexts with recent data, and provides regret and accuracy results for this recall-versus-relearning policy. Its reusable contexts have only an incidental connection to compositionality, while its main contribution to context-based memory and prediction policies merits a strong Systems score.

    MICE 通过混合已存储上下文与近期数据来应对反复出现的概念漂移，并为这种回忆与重学策略提供遗憾和准确率方面的结果。其可复用上下文与组合性只有附带关联，而其对基于上下文的记忆和预测策略的主要贡献值得获得较高的系统评分。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are being applied to Web data streams such as network intrusion detection, where they adapt by updating the labelled rows of their context without retraining. When a past concept returns after leaving the context, a TFM faces a recall-or-relearn decision between restoring stored rows of the concept and relearning it from new labels. We propose MICE (Mixture of In-Context Experts), a training-free learner that cuts the stream into segments at detected changes. It merges a closed segment into a stored context when the TFM's estimated additional error on the segment is within a tolerance, under a capacity limit on stored contexts. A fast level weights the stored contexts and first-in-first-out (FIFO) windows by the log-loss of their predictions on the last labelled batch. We show that, with pure stored contexts and a margin condition, this fast level gains over relearning, in expected accuracy, the normalised positive area between the stored context's accuracy and the TFM's learning curve, up to a first-batch term. A slow level mixes the fast level's prediction with that of the FIFO window of the last labelled rows and bounds the discounted half-Brier regret of MICE against this window at every time. Learning curves measured beforehand predict the ordering of the observed recall gains. MICE outperforms reset, which empties the context at detected drifts, on grid streams with random boundary phases. Merging keeps fewer experts than pools that store every segment, and with fixed segmentation a time-matched snapshot pool matches MICE on the shifted grid. On real streams, MICE has the highest mean accuracy of all policies we compare.

    中文

    表格基础模型（TFM）正应用于网络入侵检测等 Web 数据流，它们通过更新上下文中的带标签行来适应变化，而无需重新训练。当过去的概念离开上下文后再次出现时，TFM 面临“回忆还是重学”的抉择：恢复该概念已存储的行，还是利用新标签重新学习。我们提出 MICE（上下文内专家混合），这是一种无需训练的学习器，会在检测到变化时将数据流切分为多个片段。当某个已结束片段上 TFM 估计的额外误差处于容许范围内时，MICE 会在存储上下文容量限制下，将该片段合并到一个已存储上下文中。快速层根据各存储上下文和先进先出（FIFO）窗口对最近一个带标签批次的预测所产生的对数损失，对它们赋予权重。我们证明，在存储上下文纯净且满足间隔条件时，与重新学习相比，该快速层在期望准确率上的收益，等于存储上下文准确率与 TFM 学习曲线之间归一化正面积，至多相差一个首批项。慢速层将快速层的预测与最近带标签行的 FIFO 窗口预测相混合，并在每个时刻对 MICE 相对于该窗口的折扣半 Brier 遗憾给出上界。事先测得的学习曲线可以预测观察到的回忆收益的排序。在具有随机边界相位的网格数据流上，MICE 优于在检测到漂移时清空上下文的 reset。合并使专家数量少于存储每个片段的专家池；在固定分段下，与 MICE 时间匹配的快照池在移位网格上可达到与 MICE 相当的表现。在真实数据流上，MICE 的平均准确率高于我们比较的所有策略。

    Coding agents are beginning to develop the production-grade AI infrastructure that trains and serves large models, yet existing benchmarks cover only single kernels or single-GPU tasks, and grade with tests and prompts that misjudge both correct and incorrect patches. We introduce InfraDev, a benchmark of 36 tasks built from real-world pull requests to Megatron-LM, vLLM, and verl, covering infrastructure development for training, inference, and reinforcement learning. Each task asks an agent to reimplement a real change that spans many files and must run correctly across many GPUs. To grade such changes, we jointly synthesize hidden probes, which enforce the requirements the original tests leave unchecked, and a prompt that states every interface the probes call without revealing the solution. Across six frontier models, the best resolves only 38.9% of the tasks; the probes reject 32% of the submissions that pass every official test, and with the original pull request descriptions as prompts, no model resolves a single task. Turning these findings into an agent skill raises the resolved rate of a frontier model on the Megatron-LM tasks by 10.5%.

    Balanced State Subspaces for Mamba-2 State Compression
